workflow arrange_delivery v1
description "Book the delivery of an order with the carrier the urgency rule chose, and answer with its tracking number. Written once for every platform, since its calls are HTTP ones that dandori writes for each (`connection` is what Step Functions needs of them): each version of fulfillment runs it as its child, a child workflow on Temporal, an invoked durable function on Lambda durable functions, a workflow of this WorkflowTemplate on Argo, a nested execution on Step Functions"

enum carrier = standard | next_day

record Booking
  tracking_number : string

inputs
  order_id  : string
  carrier   : carrier
  recipient : string?
  extra     : json

outputs
  tracking_number : string

# The next-day carrier sends a van for the parcels; on a busy day it has no van left.
task book_next_day(order_id: string, recipient: string?) -> Booking
  http POST "https://next-day.example.com/v1/pickups"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/next-day/2a3b4c"
  errors no_van = 409
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task book_standard(order_id: string, recipient: string?, extra: json) -> Booking
  http POST "https://post.example.com/v1/parcels"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/post/3b4c5d"
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  match carrier
    next_day =>
      let booked = book_next_day(order_id: order_id, recipient: recipient)
        on no_van => fail NoVan "No next-day van is left for order {order_id}"
      succeed tracking_number = booked.tracking_number
    standard =>
      let booked = book_standard(order_id: order_id, recipient: recipient, extra: extra)
      succeed tracking_number = booked.tracking_number

workflow 配送の手配 v1
description "注文の配送を、急ぎの規則が選んだ便で頼み、追跡番号を返す。呼び出しはどれも、dandori がプラットフォームごとに生成する HTTP の呼び出しなので、すべてのプラットフォーム向けにこの一つだけを書く（`connection` は Step Functions のためのもの）。引当と発送のどの版も、これを子として走らせる。Temporal では子ワークフロー、Lambda durable functions では invoke する durable function、Argo ではこの WorkflowTemplate のワークフロー、Step Functions ではネストした実行になる"

enum 便 = 通常便 | 翌日便

record 集荷
  追跡番号 : string

inputs
  注文ID : string
  便     : 便
  宛名   : string?
  付帯   : json

outputs
  追跡番号 : string

# 翌日便の運送会社は、荷物を取りに車を出す。忙しい日には、空いている車がないことがある。
task 翌日便を頼む(注文ID: string, 宛名: string?) -> 集荷
  http POST "https://next-day.example.com/v1/pickups"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/next-day/2a3b4c"
  errors 空きなし = 409
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task 通常便を頼む(注文ID: string, 宛名: string?, 付帯: json) -> 集荷
  http POST "https://post.example.com/v1/parcels"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/post/3b4c5d"
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  match 便
    翌日便 =>
      let 受付 = 翌日便を頼む(注文ID: 注文ID, 宛名: 宛名)
        on 空きなし => fail 翌日便の空きなし "注文 {注文ID} の翌日便の車が空いていません"
      succeed 追跡番号 = 受付.追跡番号
    通常便 =>
      let 受付 = 通常便を頼む(注文ID: 注文ID, 宛名: 宛名, 付帯: 付帯)
      succeed 追跡番号 = 受付.追跡番号

workflow fulfillment v1 implements shop.FulfillmentService
description "Reserve stock for each line of an order, arrange the delivery, wait for the warehouse to pack it, and then tell the customer. The lines are reserved side by side, and when one is short, what was reserved is released. Written for AWS, for Step Functions and Lambda durable functions: the rule is a Lambda function, the warehouse is called by Connect through an EventBridge connection, the delivery is arrange_delivery.flow started by the ARN it is deployed as, the packing request goes to SQS with the task token in the message, the customer hears by SNS, and the audit log is a Lambda function. The other platforms run it too, with the calls dandori writes for each"

use rule urgency from "../../order/rules/urgency.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:urgency"
use proto shop from "../specs/fulfillment.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"
use smithy sns from "../specs/sns.json"
use smithy sqs from "../specs/sqs.json"

record Line
  sku      : string
  quantity : int

record Gift
  recipient : string
  message   : string?

record Order
  id     : string
  member : bool
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  lines  : list[Line]
  gift   : Gift?
  extra  : json

record Delivery
  tracking_number : string

record PackingRequest
  order_id     : string
  reservations : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record Packing
  boxes : int

record Sent
  MessageId : string

inputs
  order : Order

outputs
  reservations    : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]
  tracking_number : string

# The warehouse answers every reservation: secured with its id, or short when the stock is short.
task reserve_stock(sku: string, quantity: int) -> warehouse.ReserveResponse
  connect warehouse "StockService/Reserve"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  errors busy = resource_exhausted
  key
  retry 2 times every 1 second on busy

task release_stock(id: string)
  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  idempotent

# Another workflow arranges the delivery, written as a .flow of its own; the checker holds this
# task to its inputs, outputs and errors. It is a child workflow on Temporal (its type and task
# queue are arrange_delivery_v1) and a workflow of its WorkflowTemplate on Argo; Step Functions
# and Lambda durable functions start it by the ARN it is deployed as.
task arrange_delivery(order_id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier, recipient: string?, extra: json) -> Delivery
  flow "../arrange_delivery.flow"
  state machine "arn:aws:states:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:stateMachine:arrange-delivery"
  durable function "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:arrange-delivery:live"

# The packing crew reads the request from a queue, and answers when the boxes are packed.
task wait_for_packing(QueueUrl: string, MessageBody: PackingRequest) -> Packing
  aws sqs:sendMessage
  callback
  timeout 2 days

task notify(TopicArn: string, Message: string) -> Sent
  aws sns:publish
  errors no_recipient = NotFoundException

task audit(order_id: string, extra: json)
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:audit-log"
  idempotent

flow
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  let results = for line in order.lines at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let r = reserve_stock(sku: line.sku, quantity: line.quantity)
    yield r
  let any_short = false
  for one in results at most 50
    match one.stock
      short => let any_short = true
      secured => pass
  match any_short
    true =>
      for taken in results at most 50 in parallel
        match taken.id
          some id => release_stock(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail OutOfStock "Order {order.id} has lines the stock is short of"
    false => pass
  let recipient: string? = none
  match order.gift
    some gift =>
      let recipient = gift.recipient
      match gift.message
        some words => audit(order_id: order.id, extra: {message: words, recipient: gift.recipient})
        none => pass
    none => pass
  let delivery = arrange_delivery(order_id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier, recipient: recipient, extra: order.extra)
    on failure => fail DeliveryFailed "Could not arrange the delivery of order {order.id}"
  let packed = wait_for_packing(QueueUrl: "https://sqs.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/packing", MessageBody: {order_id: order.id, reservations: results})
    on timeout => fail PackingLate "No word of the packing in two days"
  notify(TopicArn: "arn:aws:sns:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:orders", Message: "Order {order.id} went out by {decision.carrier} ({packed.boxes} boxes, tracking number {delivery.tracking_number})")
    on no_recipient => pass
  succeed reservations = results, tracking_number = delivery.tracking_number

workflow 引当と発送 v1 implements 店.FulfillmentService
description "注文の明細ごとに在庫を引き当て、配送を手配し、倉庫の梱包を待ってから、お客さまに知らせる。明細は並べて引き当て、足りない明細があれば、引き当てたぶんを戻す。AWS 向けの版（Step Functions と Lambda durable functions）：規則は Lambda 関数で、倉庫は EventBridge の接続を通して Connect で呼ぶ。配送の手配は、デプロイした ARN で始める arrange_delivery.ja.flow。梱包の依頼は、メッセージにタスクトークンを入れて SQS に送り、お客さまへは SNS で知らせ、記録は Lambda 関数に残す。ほかのプラットフォームでも、dandori がそれぞれ向けに生成する呼び出しで動く"

use rule 急ぎ from "../../order/rules/出荷の急ぎ.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:urgency"
use proto 店 from "../specs/fulfillment.ja.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"
use smithy sns from "../specs/sns.json"
use smithy sqs from "../specs/sqs.json"

record 明細
  sku : string
  数  : int

record 贈り物
  宛名       : string
  メッセージ : string?

record 注文
  id     : string
  会員   : bool
  金額   : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  明細   : list[明細]
  贈り物 : 贈り物?
  付帯   : json

record 配送
  追跡番号 : string

record 梱包の依頼
  注文ID : string
  引当   : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record 梱包
  箱の数 : int

record 送信
  MessageId : string

inputs
  注文 : 注文

outputs
  引当     : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]
  追跡番号 : string

# 倉庫は、どの引当にも答える。在庫を押さえられたら secured とその ID、足りなければ short。
task 在庫を引き当てる(sku: string, quantity: int) -> warehouse.ReserveResponse
  connect warehouse "StockService/Reserve"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  errors 混雑 = resource_exhausted
  key
  retry 2 times every 1 second on 混雑

task 引当を戻す(id: string)
  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  idempotent

# 別のワークフローが配送を手配する。それ自身の .flow で書いてあり、検査はこのタスクを、その
# 入力・出力・エラーと突き合わせる。Temporal では子ワークフロー（型とタスクキューは 配送の手配_v1）、
# Argo ではその WorkflowTemplate のワークフローで、Step Functions と Lambda durable functions は、
# デプロイした ARN で始める。
task 配送を手配する(注文ID: string, 便: 急ぎ.便, 宛名: string?, 付帯: json) -> 配送
  flow "../arrange_delivery.ja.flow"
  state machine "arn:aws:states:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:stateMachine:arrange-delivery"
  durable function "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:arrange-delivery:live"

# 梱包の担当者はキューから依頼を読み、箱詰めが済むと応答する。
task 梱包を待つ(QueueUrl: string, MessageBody: 梱包の依頼) -> 梱包
  aws sqs:sendMessage
  callback
  timeout 2 days

task 知らせる(TopicArn: string, Message: string) -> 送信
  aws sns:publish
  errors 宛先なし = NotFoundException

task 記録する(注文ID: string, 付帯: json)
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:audit-log"
  idempotent

flow
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 注文.会員, 金額: 注文.金額)
  let 結果 = for 明細 in 注文.明細 at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let 答え = 在庫を引き当てる(sku: 明細.sku, quantity: 明細.数)
    yield 答え
  let 足りない = false
  for 一つ in 結果 at most 50
    match 一つ.stock
      short => let 足りない = true
      secured => pass
  match 足りない
    true =>
      for 戻す in 結果 at most 50 in parallel
        match 戻す.id
          some id => 引当を戻す(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail 在庫不足 "注文 {注文.id} には在庫の足りない明細があります"
    false => pass
  let 宛名: string? = none
  match 注文.贈り物
    some 贈り物 =>
      let 宛名 = 贈り物.宛名
      match 贈り物.メッセージ
        some 一言 => 記録する(注文ID: 注文.id, 付帯: {メッセージ: 一言, 宛名: 贈り物.宛名})
        none => pass
    none => pass
  let 配送 = 配送を手配する(注文ID: 注文.id, 便: 判定.便, 宛名: 宛名, 付帯: 注文.付帯)
    on failure => fail 配送の手配の失敗 "注文 {注文.id} の配送を手配できませんでした"
  let 箱 = 梱包を待つ(QueueUrl: "https://sqs.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/packing", MessageBody: {注文ID: 注文.id, 引当: 結果})
    on timeout => fail 梱包の遅れ "二日たっても梱包の知らせがありません"
  知らせる(TopicArn: "arn:aws:sns:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:orders", Message: "注文 {注文.id} を{判定.便}で出しました（{箱.箱の数} 箱、追跡番号 {配送.追跡番号}）")
    on 宛先なし => pass
  succeed 引当 = 結果, 追跡番号 = 配送.追跡番号
texts.crates/dandori/examples/fulfillment/pyda:
workflow fulfillment v1 implements shop.FulfillmentService
description "Reserve stock for each line of an order, arrange the delivery, wait for the warehouse to pack it, and then tell the customer. The lines are reserved side by side, and when one is short, what was reserved is released. Written for pydantic-graph: the graph runs in the Python process that takes the order. The warehouse's calls are functions dandori writes, by Connect, which send with the standard library; the arrangement of the delivery, the packing request, the notice and the audit log are functions you write; and the packing crew's answer comes to the callback in the same process. The wait for the packing holds the process, and a run the process loses is lost"

use rule urgency from "../../order/rules/urgency.rule"
use proto shop from "../specs/fulfillment.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"

record Line
  sku      : string
  quantity : int

record Gift
  recipient : string
  message   : string?

record Order
  id     : string
  member : bool
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  lines  : list[Line]
  gift   : Gift?
  extra  : json

record Delivery
  tracking_number : string

record PackingRequest
  order_id     : string
  reservations : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record Packing
  boxes : int

inputs
  order : Order

outputs
  reservations    : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]
  tracking_number : string

# The warehouse answers every reservation: secured with its id, or short when the stock is short.
task reserve_stock(sku: string, quantity: int) -> warehouse.ReserveResponse
  connect warehouse "StockService/Reserve"
  errors busy = resource_exhausted
  key
  retry 2 times every 1 second on busy

task release_stock(id: string)
  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  idempotent

# Arranging the delivery is a function you write: the graph of arrange_delivery.flow, or a call to
# the delivery team. The checker holds this task to that .flow's inputs, outputs and errors.
task arrange_delivery(order_id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier, recipient: string?, extra: json) -> Delivery
  flow "../arrange_delivery.flow"

# The packing crew's app gets the request and the callback's id from the function you write,
# and answers the callback when the boxes are packed.
task wait_for_packing(order_id: string, reservations: list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]) -> Packing
  callback
  timeout 2 days

# The shop's own notice service.
task notify(order_id: string, text: string)
  errors no_recipient

task audit(order_id: string, extra: json)
  idempotent

flow
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  let results = for line in order.lines at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let r = reserve_stock(sku: line.sku, quantity: line.quantity)
    yield r
  let any_short = false
  for one in results at most 50
    match one.stock
      short => let any_short = true
      secured => pass
  match any_short
    true =>
      for taken in results at most 50 in parallel
        match taken.id
          some id => release_stock(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail OutOfStock "Order {order.id} has lines the stock is short of"
    false => pass
  let recipient: string? = none
  match order.gift
    some gift =>
      let recipient = gift.recipient
      match gift.message
        some words => audit(order_id: order.id, extra: {message: words, recipient: gift.recipient})
        none => pass
    none => pass
  let delivery = arrange_delivery(order_id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier, recipient: recipient, extra: order.extra)
    on failure => fail DeliveryFailed "Could not arrange the delivery of order {order.id}"
  let packed = wait_for_packing(order_id: order.id, reservations: results)
    on timeout => fail PackingLate "No word of the packing in two days"
  notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Order {order.id} went out by {decision.carrier} ({packed.boxes} boxes, tracking number {delivery.tracking_number})")
    on no_recipient => pass
  succeed reservations = results, tracking_number = delivery.tracking_number

workflow 引当と発送 v1 implements 店.FulfillmentService
description "注文の明細ごとに在庫を引き当て、配送を手配し、倉庫の梱包を待ってから、お客さまに知らせる。明細は並べて引き当て、足りない明細があれば、引き当てたぶんを戻す。pydantic-graph 向けの版：グラフは注文を受け取る Python のプロセスの中で動く。倉庫の呼び出しは dandori が Connect で生成する関数で、標準ライブラリで送る。配送の手配、梱包の依頼、お知らせ、記録は自分で書く関数で、梱包の担当者の応答は、同じプロセスの中でコールバックに届く。梱包を待っているあいだはプロセスがふさがり、プロセスが失われると実行も失われる"

use proto 店 from "../specs/fulfillment.ja.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"

record 明細
  sku : string
  数  : int

record 贈り物
  宛名       : string
  メッセージ : string?

record 注文
  id     : string
  会員   : bool
  金額   : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  明細   : list[明細]
  贈り物 : 贈り物?
  付帯   : json

record 配送
  追跡番号 : string

record 梱包の依頼
  注文ID : string
  引当   : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record 梱包
  箱の数 : int

  注文 : 注文

  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  idempotent

task 配送を手配する(注文ID: string, 便: 急ぎ.便, 宛名: string?, 付帯: json) -> 配送
  flow "../arrange_delivery.ja.flow"

# 梱包の担当者のアプリは、自分で書く関数から依頼とコールバックの ID を受け取り、箱詰めが
# 済むとコールバックに応答する。
task 梱包を待つ(注文ID: string, 引当: list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]) -> 梱包

  timeout 2 days

# お店の通知サービス。
task 知らせる(注文ID: string, 本文: string)
  errors 宛先なし

task 記録する(注文ID: string, 付帯: json)
  idempotent

flow
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 注文.会員, 金額: 注文.金額)
  let 結果 = for 明細 in 注文.明細 at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let 答え = 在庫を引き当てる(sku: 明細.sku, quantity: 明細.数)
    yield 答え
  let 足りない = false
  for 一つ in 結果 at most 50
    match 一つ.stock
      short => let 足りない = true
      secured => pass
  match 足りない
    true =>
      for 戻す in 結果 at most 50 in parallel
        match 戻す.id
          some id => 引当を戻す(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail 在庫不足 "注文 {注文.id} には在庫の足りない明細があります"
    false => pass
  let 宛名: string? = none
  match 注文.贈り物
    some 贈り物 =>
      let 宛名 = 贈り物.宛名
      match 贈り物.メッセージ
        some 一言 => 記録する(注文ID: 注文.id, 付帯: {メッセージ: 一言, 宛名: 贈り物.宛名})

workflow fulfillment v1 implements shop.FulfillmentService
description "Reserve stock for each line of an order, arrange the delivery, wait for the warehouse to pack it, and then tell the customer. The lines are reserved side by side, and when one is short, what was reserved is released. Written for Temporal: the warehouse's calls are activities dandori writes, by Connect; a workflow of the delivery team, on its own task queue, arranges the delivery (a child workflow, arrange_delivery.flow), and when it finds no next-day van the standard carrier is asked; and the packing request, the notice and the audit log are activities you write, the packing crew answering the callback by the update the generated client sends"

use rule urgency from "../../order/rules/urgency.rule"
use proto shop from "../specs/fulfillment.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"

record Line
  sku      : string
  quantity : int

record Gift
  recipient : string
  message   : string?

record Order
  id     : string
  member : bool
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  lines  : list[Line]
  gift   : Gift?
  extra  : json

record Delivery
  tracking_number : string

record PackingRequest
  order_id     : string
  reservations : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record Packing
  boxes : int

inputs
  order : Order

outputs
  reservations    : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]
  tracking_number : string

# The warehouse answers every reservation: secured with its id, or short when the stock is short.
task reserve_stock(sku: string, quantity: int) -> warehouse.ReserveResponse
  connect warehouse "StockService/Reserve"
  errors busy = resource_exhausted
  key
  retry 2 times every 1 second on busy

task release_stock(id: string)
  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  idempotent

# The delivery team's workflow arranges the delivery, on the workers of its own task queue. It is
# written as a .flow of its own, and the checker holds this task to its inputs, outputs and errors.
task arrange_delivery(order_id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier, recipient: string?, extra: json) -> Delivery
  flow "../arrange_delivery.flow"
  errors NoVan

# The packing crew's app gets the request and the callback's id from the function you write,
# and answers the callback when the boxes are packed.
task wait_for_packing(order_id: string, reservations: list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]) -> Packing
  callback
  timeout 2 days

# The shop's own notice service.
task notify(order_id: string, text: string)
  errors no_recipient

task audit(order_id: string, extra: json)
  idempotent

flow
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  let results = for line in order.lines at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let r = reserve_stock(sku: line.sku, quantity: line.quantity)
    yield r
  let any_short = false
  for one in results at most 50
    match one.stock
      short => let any_short = true
      secured => pass
  match any_short
    true =>
      for taken in results at most 50 in parallel
        match taken.id
          some id => release_stock(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail OutOfStock "Order {order.id} has lines the stock is short of"
    false => pass
  let recipient: string? = none
  match order.gift
    some gift =>
      let recipient = gift.recipient
      match gift.message
        some words => audit(order_id: order.id, extra: {message: words, recipient: gift.recipient})
        none => pass
    none => pass
  let delivery = arrange_delivery(order_id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier, recipient: recipient, extra: order.extra)
    on NoVan =>
      let delivery = arrange_delivery(order_id: order.id, carrier: standard, recipient: recipient, extra: order.extra)
        on failure => fail DeliveryFailed "Could not arrange the delivery of order {order.id}"
    on failure => fail DeliveryFailed "Could not arrange the delivery of order {order.id}"
  let packed = wait_for_packing(order_id: order.id, reservations: results)
    on timeout => fail PackingLate "No word of the packing in two days"
  notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Order {order.id} went out by {decision.carrier} ({packed.boxes} boxes, tracking number {delivery.tracking_number})")
    on no_recipient => pass
  succeed reservations = results, tracking_number = delivery.tracking_number

workflow 引当と発送 v1 implements 店.FulfillmentService
description "注文の明細ごとに在庫を引き当て、配送を手配し、倉庫の梱包を待ってから、お客さまに知らせる。明細は並べて引き当て、足りない明細があれば、引き当てたぶんを戻す。Temporal 向けの版：倉庫の呼び出しは dandori が Connect で生成するアクティビティ。配送チームのワークフローが専用のタスクキューで配送を手配し（子ワークフロー、arrange_delivery.ja.flow）、翌日便の車がなければ通常便で頼み直す。梱包の依頼、お知らせ、記録は自分で書くアクティビティで、梱包の担当者は、生成したクライアントが送る Update でコールバックに応答する"

use rule 急ぎ from "../../order/rules/出荷の急ぎ.rule"
use proto 店 from "../specs/fulfillment.ja.proto"
use proto warehouse from "../specs/warehouse.proto"
  url "https://warehouse.example.com"

record 明細
  sku : string
  数  : int

record 贈り物
  宛名       : string
  メッセージ : string?

record 注文
  id     : string
  会員   : bool
  金額   : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  明細   : list[明細]
  贈り物 : 贈り物?
  付帯   : json

record 配送
  追跡番号 : string

record 梱包の依頼
  注文ID : string
  引当   : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]

record 梱包
  箱の数 : int

inputs
  注文 : 注文

outputs
  引当     : list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]
  追跡番号 : string

# 倉庫は、どの引当にも答える。在庫を押さえられたら secured とその ID、足りなければ short。
task 在庫を引き当てる(sku: string, quantity: int) -> warehouse.ReserveResponse
  connect warehouse "StockService/Reserve"
  errors 混雑 = resource_exhausted
  key
  retry 2 times every 1 second on 混雑

task 引当を戻す(id: string)
  connect warehouse "StockService/Release"
  idempotent

# 配送チームのワークフローが、専用のタスクキューのワーカーで配送を手配する。それ自身の .flow で
# 書いてあり、検査はこのタスクを、その入力・出力・エラーと突き合わせる。
task 配送を手配する(注文ID: string, 便: 急ぎ.便, 宛名: string?, 付帯: json) -> 配送
  flow "../arrange_delivery.ja.flow"
  errors 翌日便の空きなし

# 梱包の担当者のアプリは、自分で書く関数から依頼とコールバックの ID を受け取り、箱詰めが
# 済むとコールバックに応答する。
task 梱包を待つ(注文ID: string, 引当: list[warehouse.ReserveResponse]) -> 梱包
  callback
  timeout 2 days

# お店の通知サービス。
task 知らせる(注文ID: string, 本文: string)
  errors 宛先なし

task 記録する(注文ID: string, 付帯: json)
  idempotent

flow
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 注文.会員, 金額: 注文.金額)
  let 結果 = for 明細 in 注文.明細 at most 50 in parallel, 10 at a time
    let 答え = 在庫を引き当てる(sku: 明細.sku, quantity: 明細.数)
    yield 答え
  let 足りない = false
  for 一つ in 結果 at most 50
    match 一つ.stock
      short => let 足りない = true
      secured => pass
  match 足りない
    true =>
      for 戻す in 結果 at most 50 in parallel
        match 戻す.id
          some id => 引当を戻す(id: id)
          none => pass
      fail 在庫不足 "注文 {注文.id} には在庫の足りない明細があります"
    false => pass
  let 宛名: string? = none
  match 注文.贈り物
    some 贈り物 =>
      let 宛名 = 贈り物.宛名
      match 贈り物.メッセージ
        some 一言 => 記録する(注文ID: 注文.id, 付帯: {メッセージ: 一言, 宛名: 贈り物.宛名})
        none => pass
    none => pass
  let 配送 = 配送を手配する(注文ID: 注文.id, 便: 判定.便, 宛名: 宛名, 付帯: 注文.付帯)
    on 翌日便の空きなし =>
      let 配送 = 配送を手配する(注文ID: 注文.id, 便: 通常便, 宛名: 宛名, 付帯: 注文.付帯)
        on failure => fail 配送の手配の失敗 "注文 {注文.id} の配送を手配できませんでした"
    on failure => fail 配送の手配の失敗 "注文 {注文.id} の配送を手配できませんでした"
  let 箱 = 梱包を待つ(注文ID: 注文.id, 引当: 結果)
    on timeout => fail 梱包の遅れ "二日たっても梱包の知らせがありません"
  知らせる(注文ID: 注文.id, 本文: "注文 {注文.id} を{判定.便}で出しました（{箱.箱の数} 箱、追跡番号 {配送.追跡番号}）")
    on 宛先なし => pass
  succeed 引当 = 結果, 追跡番号 = 配送.追跡番号
workflow hotel_stay v1
description "When a stay is booked, hold an amount on the card, and capture it on the day of check-out. A rule decides the amount and whether the front desk looks first; the payment is a Stripe PaymentIntent. Written for AWS, for Step Functions and Lambda durable functions: the rule is a Lambda function, the Stripe calls go through an EventBridge connection, and the customer's 3-D Secure step is a Lambda function that keeps the task token until Stripe's webhook says the PaymentIntent moved. The other platforms run it too, with the calls dandori writes for each"

use rule hold from "../rules/hold_amount.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:hold-amount"
use rule payment_intent from "../rules/payment_intent.rule"
use openapi stripe from "../specs/stripe.json"

record Booking
  id        : string
  room      : hold.room
  nights    : int  range >=1 <=30
  card      : string
  check_out : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum Outcome = stayed | awaiting_review

inputs
  booking : Booking

outputs
  outcome : Outcome

task create_intent(amount: money[JPY, incl_tax] range >=50 <=99999999, currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task confirm_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends confirm
  errors card_declined = 402, unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task capture_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends capture
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task cancel_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/cancel"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends cancel
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task get_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# The customer's 3-D Secure step: a Lambda function keeps the task token until Stripe's
# webhook says the PaymentIntent moved, and then hands it back with the PaymentIntent.
task wait_for_customer(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:stripe-webhook-inbox"
  callback
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case pi : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let quote = hold(room: booking.room, nights: booking.nights)
  match quote.handling
    review => succeed outcome = awaiting_review
    auto => pi <- create_intent(amount: quote.amount, currency: "jpy", payment_method: booking.card, capture_method: manual)
  pi <- confirm_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on card_declined => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
  match pi.status
    requires_action =>
      pi <- wait_for_customer(id: pi.id)
        on timeout => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match pi.status
    requires_capture => wait until booking.check_out
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => pass
      fail CardDeclined "The card could not be held"
    canceled => fail PaymentCanceled "The PaymentIntent was canceled"
  pi <- capture_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on unexpected_state => fail HoldExpired "The hold had expired by check-out"
  match pi.status
    succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
        match pi.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match pi.status
        succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail SettlementUnclear "The capture has no clear outcome; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

on failure
  match pi.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => fail CleanupFailed "Stripe refused to release the hold; the capture may have gone through. Handing it over to staff" leaving pi
        on failure => fail CleanupFailed "Releasing the hold failed; handing it over to staff" leaving pi
    processing => fail SettlementUnclear "Failed in the middle of the capture; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

workflow 宿泊 v1
description "宿泊の予約を受けたらカードに与信を取り、チェックアウトの日に売上を確定する。与信の額と、フロントが先に確認するかどうかは規則が決め、決済は Stripe の PaymentIntent で行う。AWS 向けの版（Step Functions と Lambda durable functions）：規則は Lambda 関数で、Stripe の呼び出しは EventBridge の接続を通す。お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続きは、Stripe の Webhook が PaymentIntent の動いたことを知らせるまでタスクトークンを預かる Lambda 関数が受け持つ。ほかのプラットフォームでも、dandori がそれぞれ向けに生成する呼び出しで動く"

use rule 与信 from "../rules/宿泊の与信額.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:hold-amount"
use rule payment_intent from "../rules/payment_intent.rule"
use openapi stripe from "../specs/stripe.json"

record 予約
  id             : string
  客室           : 与信.客室
  泊数           : int  range >=1 <=30
  カード         : string
  チェックアウト : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum 結果 = 宿泊済 | 確認待ち

inputs
  予約 : 予約

outputs
  結果 : 結果

task 決済を作る(amount: money[円, incl_tax] range >=50 <=99999999, currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task 与信を取る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends confirm
  errors カード拒否 = 402, 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 売上を確定する(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends capture
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task 与信を取り消す(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/cancel"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends cancel
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 決済を見る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続き。Lambda 関数がタスクトークンを預かり、Stripe の Webhook が
# PaymentIntent の動いたことを知らせると、その PaymentIntent と一緒にトークンを返す。
task 本人認証を待つ(決済ID: string) -> PaymentIntent
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:stripe-webhook-inbox"
  callback
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case 決済 : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let 見積 = 与信(客室: 予約.客室, 泊数: 予約.泊数)
  match 見積.扱い
    確認 => succeed 結果 = 確認待ち
    自動 => 決済 <- 決済を作る(amount: 見積.与信額, currency: "jpy", payment_method: 予約.カード, capture_method: manual)
  決済 <- 与信を取る(intent: 決済.id)
    on カード拒否 => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
  match 決済.status
    requires_action =>
      決済 <- 本人認証を待つ(決済ID: 決済.id)
        on timeout => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match 決済.status
    requires_capture => wait until 予約.チェックアウト
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => pass
      fail 与信不可 "カードの与信が取れませんでした"
    canceled => fail 決済の取消 "PaymentIntent が取り消されていました"
  決済 <- 売上を確定する(intent: 決済.id)
    on 状態の不一致 => fail 与信の有効期限切れ "チェックアウトまでに与信の有効期限が切れていました"
  match 決済.status
    succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
        match 決済.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match 決済.status
        succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の結果が分かりません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

on failure
  match 決済.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => fail 取消の失敗 "Stripe が与信の取消を拒否しました。売上が確定しているかもしれません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "与信を取り消せませんでした。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
    processing => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の途中で失敗しました。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# The customer's 3-D Secure step: the function hands the callback's id to the page that runs
# it, and the shop's webhook handler answers it with the PaymentIntent once Stripe says it moved.
task wait_for_customer(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  callback
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case pi : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let quote = hold(room: booking.room, nights: booking.nights)
  match quote.handling
    review => succeed outcome = awaiting_review
    auto => pi <- create_intent(amount: quote.amount, currency: "jpy", payment_method: booking.card, capture_method: manual)
  pi <- confirm_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on card_declined => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
  match pi.status
    requires_action =>
      pi <- wait_for_customer(id: pi.id)
        on timeout => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match pi.status
    requires_capture => wait until booking.check_out
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => pass
      fail CardDeclined "The card could not be held"
    canceled => fail PaymentCanceled "The PaymentIntent was canceled"
  pi <- capture_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on unexpected_state => fail HoldExpired "The hold had expired by check-out"
  match pi.status
    succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
        match pi.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match pi.status
        succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail SettlementUnclear "The capture has no clear outcome; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

on failure
  match pi.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => fail CleanupFailed "Stripe refused to release the hold; the capture may have gone through. Handing it over to staff" leaving pi
        on failure => fail CleanupFailed "Releasing the hold failed; handing it over to staff" leaving pi
    processing => fail SettlementUnclear "Failed in the middle of the capture; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

workflow 宿泊 v1
description "宿泊の予約を受けたらカードに与信を取り、チェックアウトの日に売上を確定する。与信の額と、フロントが先に確認するかどうかは規則が決め、決済は Stripe の PaymentIntent で行う。pydantic-graph 向けの版：グラフは予約を受け取る Python のプロセスの中で動く。Stripe の呼び出しは dandori が生成する関数で、Transport を通して標準ライブラリで送る。規則はプロセスの中で動き、お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続きは、同じプロセスにあるお店の Webhook のハンドラーが応答するコールバックにする。待っているあいだはプロセスがふさがり、プロセスが失われると実行も失われる"

use rule 与信 from "../rules/宿泊の与信額.rule"
use rule payment_intent from "../rules/payment_intent.rule"
use openapi stripe from "../specs/stripe.json"

record 予約
  id             : string
  客室           : 与信.客室
  泊数           : int  range >=1 <=30
  カード         : string
  チェックアウト : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum 結果 = 宿泊済 | 確認待ち

inputs
  予約 : 予約

outputs
  結果 : 結果

task 決済を作る(amount: money[円, incl_tax] range >=50 <=99999999, currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task 与信を取る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm"
  sends confirm
  errors カード拒否 = 402, 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 売上を確定する(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture"
  sends capture
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task 与信を取り消す(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/cancel"
  sends cancel
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 決済を見る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続き。関数はコールバックの ID を手続きのページに渡し、Stripe が
# PaymentIntent の動いたことを知らせると、お店の Webhook のハンドラーがその PaymentIntent で応答する。
task 本人認証を待つ(決済ID: string) -> PaymentIntent
  callback
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case 決済 : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let 見積 = 与信(客室: 予約.客室, 泊数: 予約.泊数)
  match 見積.扱い
    確認 => succeed 結果 = 確認待ち
    自動 => 決済 <- 決済を作る(amount: 見積.与信額, currency: "jpy", payment_method: 予約.カード, capture_method: manual)
  決済 <- 与信を取る(intent: 決済.id)
    on カード拒否 => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
  match 決済.status
    requires_action =>
      決済 <- 本人認証を待つ(決済ID: 決済.id)
        on timeout => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match 決済.status
    requires_capture => wait until 予約.チェックアウト
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => pass
      fail 与信不可 "カードの与信が取れませんでした"
    canceled => fail 決済の取消 "PaymentIntent が取り消されていました"
  決済 <- 売上を確定する(intent: 決済.id)
    on 状態の不一致 => fail 与信の有効期限切れ "チェックアウトまでに与信の有効期限が切れていました"
  match 決済.status
    succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
        match 決済.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match 決済.status
        succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の結果が分かりません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

on failure
  match 決済.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => fail 取消の失敗 "Stripe が与信の取消を拒否しました。売上が確定しているかもしれません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "与信を取り消せませんでした。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
    processing => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の途中で失敗しました。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

rule payment_intent v1
description "Where a Stripe PaymentIntent's status goes when it is confirmed, authenticated, captured or canceled, and when a delayed payment settles. Transcribed from Stripe's documentation"

# Read on 25 September 2026. The comments name the pages as follows:
#   lifecycle  https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paymentintents/lifecycle
#   status     https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/verifying-status
#   confirm    https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/confirm
#   cancel     https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/cancel
#   capture    https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/capture
#   hold       https://docs.stripe.com/payments/place-a-hold-on-a-payment-method
#   3ds        https://docs.stripe.com/payments/3d-secure/authentication-flow
#   errors     https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes (payment_intent_unexpected_state)
# A row the pages do not settle says so at its end, with what was assumed.

enum status = requires_payment_method | requires_confirmation | requires_action | processing | requires_capture | succeeded | canceled
enum event = attach | confirm | authenticate | settle | capture | cancel | expire
# The two methods are Stripe's own enums, and both have `automatic` and `manual`. The hold
# page also describes `automatic_delayed`, in private preview and not in the object's enum.
enum capture_method = automatic | automatic_async | manual
enum confirmation_method = automatic | manual
enum funds = untouched | held | captured | released

group unconfirmed = requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation

inputs
  status              : status
  event               : event                # attach: a payment method is attached without confirming
  limit_reached       : bool                 # this confirmation is past the limit Stripe puts on one PaymentIntent, which varies
  needs_action        : bool                 # the payment method asks for a further step, such as 3D Secure
  approved            : bool                 # the issuer or the bank lets the attempt through; for a cancel, Stripe accepts it
  delayed             : bool                 # the payment method confirms success only days later, as a bank debit does
  capture_method      : capture_method
  confirmation_method : confirmation_method

outputs
  next_status : status
  funds       : funds
  refused     : bool                         # the status does not take this event: an API call gets payment_intent_unexpected_state

# The 3ds page tells the step after authentication differently: Stripe attempts the charge and
# the PaymentIntent moves to processing, card or not. The lifecycle and status pages keep
# processing for payment methods that confirm later, and the rows below follow them.
table transition  # lifecycle, status, and the API reference for each call
policy unique
| status           | event                                          | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method             | confirmation_method | -> next_status          | funds     | refused |
| unconfirmed      | attach                                         | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | requires_confirmation   | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle; from requires_confirmation, assumed the same
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | true          | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | untouched | false   |  # confirm
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | false         | true         | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | requires_action         | untouched | false   |  # confirm
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | false         | false        | false    | -       | -                          | -                   | requires_payment_method | untouched | false   |  # confirm
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | false         | false        | true     | -       | manual                     | -                   | requires_capture        | held      | false   |  # confirm
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | false         | false        | true     | true    | automatic, automatic_async | -                   | processing              | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle
| unconfirmed      | confirm                                        | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic, automatic_async | -                   | succeeded               | captured  | false   |  # confirm
| unconfirmed      | cancel                                         | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | untouched | false   |  # cancel
| unconfirmed      | authenticate, settle, capture, expire          | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # capture, errors
| requires_action  | authenticate                                   | -             | -            | false    | -       | -                          | -                   | requires_payment_method | untouched | false   |  # 3ds
| requires_action  | authenticate                                   | -             | -            | true     | -       | -                          | manual              | requires_confirmation   | untouched | false   |  # confirm
| requires_action  | authenticate                                   | -             | -            | true     | -       | manual                     | automatic           | requires_capture        | held      | false   |  # 3ds
| requires_action  | authenticate                                   | -             | -            | true     | true    | automatic, automatic_async | automatic           | processing              | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle
| requires_action  | authenticate                                   | -             | -            | true     | false   | automatic, automatic_async | automatic           | succeeded               | captured  | false   |  # 3ds, lifecycle
| requires_action  | cancel                                         | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | untouched | false   |  # cancel
| requires_action  | attach, confirm, settle, capture, expire       | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # errors; for attach and confirm the pages say nothing, assumed refused
| processing       | settle                                         | -             | -            | true     | -       | -                          | -                   | succeeded               | captured  | false   |  # lifecycle, status
| processing       | settle                                         | -             | -            | false    | -       | -                          | -                   | requires_payment_method | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle
| processing       | cancel                                         | -             | -            | true     | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle: ACH, ACSS, AU BECS, BACS, NZ BECS and SEPA, inside a window
| processing       | cancel                                         | -             | -            | false    | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # lifecycle; cancel says "in rare cases"
| processing       | attach, confirm, authenticate, capture, expire | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # errors
| requires_capture | capture                                        | -             | -            | -        | false   | -                          | -                   | succeeded               | captured  | false   |  # capture, lifecycle
| requires_capture | capture                                        | -             | -            | -        | true    | -                          | -                   | processing              | untouched | false   |  # lifecycle names no method; hold says bank debits cannot be held
| requires_capture | cancel                                         | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | released  | false   |  # cancel
| requires_capture | expire                                         | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | canceled                | released  | false   |  # hold, capture
| requires_capture | attach, confirm, authenticate, settle          | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # errors
| succeeded        | -                                              | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # lifecycle, status: refunds go through the Refunds API
| canceled         | -                                              | -             | -            | -        | -       | -                          | -                   | status                  | untouched | true    |  # cancel, lifecycle

# A case keeps the two methods it was created with, and may change payment method between
# attempts. Whether a retry uses a card or a bank debit is `delayed`, passed on every call.
machine payment over transition
  carry   status -> next_status
  held    capture_method, confirmation_method
  initial requires_payment_method
  final   succeeded, canceled
  never   succeeded after canceled
  once    funds captured

# 3ds: a card that asks for 3D Secure, and a customer who passes it.
scenario card_with_3ds
| event        | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method  | confirmation_method | -> next_status  | funds     | refused |
| confirm      | false         | true         | false    | false   | automatic_async | automatic           | requires_action | untouched | false   |
| authenticate | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic_async | automatic           | succeeded       | captured  | false   |

# hold: a hotel authorizes at booking and captures at check-out.
scenario authorize_then_capture
| event   | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status   | funds    | refused |
| confirm | false         | false        | true     | false   | manual         | automatic           | requires_capture | held     | false   |
| capture | false         | false        | true     | false   | manual         | automatic           | succeeded        | captured | false   |

# hold, capture: nobody captures, and the authorization runs out.
scenario hold_expires
| event   | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status   | funds     | refused |
| confirm | false         | false        | true     | false   | manual         | automatic           | requires_capture | held      | false   |
| expire  | false         | false        | false    | false   | manual         | automatic           | canceled         | released  | false   |
| capture | false         | false        | true     | false   | manual         | automatic           | canceled         | untouched | true    |

# lifecycle: a bank debit that fails days later, and a card that goes through on the retry.
scenario debit_fails_card_retries
| event   | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status          | funds     | refused |
| confirm | false         | false        | true     | true    | automatic      | automatic           | processing              | untouched | false   |
| cancel  | false         | false        | false    | true    | automatic      | automatic           | processing              | untouched | true    |
| settle  | false         | false        | false    | true    | automatic      | automatic           | requires_payment_method | untouched | false   |
| confirm | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic      | automatic           | succeeded               | captured  | false   |

# confirm: with manual confirmation, the server confirms again after the customer's step.
scenario manual_confirmation
| event        | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status        | funds     | refused |
| attach       | false         | false        | false    | false   | automatic      | manual              | requires_confirmation | untouched | false   |
| confirm      | false         | true         | false    | false   | automatic      | manual              | requires_action       | untouched | false   |
| authenticate | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic      | manual              | requires_confirmation | untouched | false   |
| confirm      | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic      | manual              | succeeded             | captured  | false   |

# confirm: declines until Stripe's limit on confirmations is reached.
scenario too_many_confirmations
| event   | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status          | funds     | refused |
| confirm | false         | false        | false    | false   | automatic      | automatic           | requires_payment_method | untouched | false   |
| confirm | true          | false        | false    | false   | automatic      | automatic           | canceled                | untouched | false   |
| confirm | false         | false        | true     | false   | automatic      | automatic           | canceled                | untouched | true    |

examples
| status           | event  | limit_reached | needs_action | approved | delayed | capture_method | confirmation_method | -> next_status | funds     | refused |
| requires_capture | cancel | false         | false        | false    | false   | manual         | automatic           | canceled       | released  | false   |
| succeeded        | cancel | false         | false        | false    | false   | automatic      | automatic           | succeeded      | untouched | true    |
| processing       | cancel | false         | false        | true     | true    | automatic      | automatic           | canceled       | untouched | false   |

If the selected payment method requires additional authentication steps, the PaymentIntent will transition to the requires_action status and suggest additional actions via next_action. If payment fails, the PaymentIntent transitions to the requires_payment_method status or the canceled status if the confirmation limit is reached. If payment succeeds, the PaymentIntent will transition to the succeeded status (or requires_capture, if capture_method is set to manual).

If the confirmation_method is automatic, payment may be attempted using our client SDKs and the PaymentIntent’s client_secret. After next_actions are handled by the client, no additional confirmation is required to complete the payment.

If the confirmation_method is manual, all payment attempts must be initiated using a secret key.

If any actions are required for the payment, the PaymentIntent will return to the requires_confirmation state after those actions are completed. Your server needs to then explicitly re-confirm the PaymentIntent to initiate the next payment attempt.

workflow hotel_stay v1
description "When a stay is booked, hold an amount on the card, and capture it on the day of check-out. A rule decides the amount and whether the front desk looks first; the payment is a Stripe PaymentIntent. Written for Temporal: the Stripe calls are activities dandori writes, and the Transport gives them the secret key; Stripe's webhook tells the workflow of the booking that the customer's 3-D Secure step is over, by the booking's id (an event); and a booking the guest cancels releases its hold (on cancel)"

use rule hold from "../rules/hold_amount.rule"
use rule payment_intent from "../rules/payment_intent.rule"
use openapi stripe from "../specs/stripe.json"

record Booking
  id        : string
  room      : hold.room
  nights    : int  range >=1 <=30
  card      : string
  check_out : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum Outcome = stayed | awaiting_review

inputs
  booking : Booking

outputs
  outcome : Outcome

task create_intent(amount: money[JPY, incl_tax] range >=50 <=99999999, currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task confirm_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm"
  sends confirm
  errors card_declined = 402, unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task capture_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture"
  sends capture
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task cancel_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/cancel"
  sends cancel
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task get_intent(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# Stripe's webhook, handled by the shop, sends the PaymentIntent as it is now to the workflow of
# the booking once the customer's 3-D Secure step is over.
task customer_authenticated() -> PaymentIntent
  event
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case pi : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let quote = hold(room: booking.room, nights: booking.nights)
  match quote.handling
    review => succeed outcome = awaiting_review
    auto => pi <- create_intent(amount: quote.amount, currency: "jpy", payment_method: booking.card, capture_method: manual)
  pi <- confirm_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on card_declined => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
  match pi.status
    requires_action =>
      pi <- customer_authenticated()
        on timeout => pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match pi.status
    requires_capture => wait until booking.check_out
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => pass
      fail CardDeclined "The card could not be held"
    canceled => fail PaymentCanceled "The PaymentIntent was canceled"
  pi <- capture_intent(intent: pi.id)
    on unexpected_state => fail HoldExpired "The hold had expired by check-out"
  match pi.status
    succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        pi <- get_intent(intent: pi.id)
        match pi.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match pi.status
        succeeded => succeed outcome = stayed
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail SettlementUnclear "The capture has no clear outcome; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

on failure
  match pi.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => fail CleanupFailed "Stripe refused to release the hold; the capture may have gone through. Handing it over to staff" leaving pi
        on failure => fail CleanupFailed "Releasing the hold failed; handing it over to staff" leaving pi
    processing => fail SettlementUnclear "Failed in the middle of the capture; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

# The guest cancels the booking: the workflow is cancelled, and whatever the card holds is released.
on cancel
  match pi.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      pi <- cancel_intent(intent: pi.id)
        on unexpected_state => fail CleanupFailed "Stripe refused to release the hold; the capture may have gone through. Handing it over to staff" leaving pi
        on failure => fail CleanupFailed "Releasing the hold failed; handing it over to staff" leaving pi
    processing => fail SettlementUnclear "Cancelled in the middle of the capture; handing it over to staff" leaving pi

workflow 宿泊 v1
description "宿泊の予約を受けたらカードに与信を取り、チェックアウトの日に売上を確定する。与信の額と、フロントが先に確認するかどうかは規則が決め、決済は Stripe の PaymentIntent で行う。Temporal 向けの版：Stripe の呼び出しは dandori が生成するアクティビティで、秘密鍵は Transport が付ける。お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続きが済んだことは、Stripe の Webhook が予約の ID を宛先にして知らせる（event）。お客さまが予約を取り消すと、与信も取り消す（on cancel）"

use rule 与信 from "../rules/宿泊の与信額.rule"
use rule payment_intent from "../rules/payment_intent.rule"
use openapi stripe from "../specs/stripe.json"

record 予約
  id             : string
  客室           : 与信.客室
  泊数           : int  range >=1 <=30
  カード         : string
  チェックアウト : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum 結果 = 宿泊済 | 確認待ち

inputs
  予約 : 予約

outputs
  結果 : 結果

task 決済を作る(amount: money[円, incl_tax] range >=50 <=99999999, currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task 与信を取る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm"
  sends confirm
  errors カード拒否 = 402, 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 売上を確定する(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/capture"
  sends capture
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task 与信を取り消す(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}/cancel"
  sends cancel
  errors 状態の不一致 = 400
  refused as 状態の不一致
  key

task 決済を見る(intent: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET stripe "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# お店が受ける Stripe の Webhook は、お客さまの 3-D セキュアの手続きが済むと、そのときの
# PaymentIntent を予約のワークフローに送る。
task 本人認証の知らせ() -> PaymentIntent
  event
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case 決済 : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let 見積 = 与信(客室: 予約.客室, 泊数: 予約.泊数)
  match 見積.扱い
    確認 => succeed 結果 = 確認待ち
    自動 => 決済 <- 決済を作る(amount: 見積.与信額, currency: "jpy", payment_method: 予約.カード, capture_method: manual)
  決済 <- 与信を取る(intent: 決済.id)
    on カード拒否 => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
  match 決済.status
    requires_action =>
      決済 <- 本人認証の知らせ()
        on timeout => 決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
    requires_capture, requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, canceled => pass
  match 決済.status
    requires_capture => wait until 予約.チェックアウト
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => pass
      fail 与信不可 "カードの与信が取れませんでした"
    canceled => fail 決済の取消 "PaymentIntent が取り消されていました"
  決済 <- 売上を確定する(intent: 決済.id)
    on 状態の不一致 => fail 与信の有効期限切れ "チェックアウトまでに与信の有効期限が切れていました"
  match 決済.status
    succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
    processing =>
      repeat at most 12 times
        wait 1 hour
        決済 <- 決済を見る(intent: 決済.id)
        match 決済.status
          processing => pass
          succeeded, requires_payment_method => break
      match 決済.status
        succeeded => succeed 結果 = 宿泊済
        processing, requires_payment_method => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の結果が分かりません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

on failure
  match 決済.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => fail 取消の失敗 "Stripe が与信の取消を拒否しました。売上が確定しているかもしれません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "与信を取り消せませんでした。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
    processing => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の途中で失敗しました。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

# お客さまが予約を取り消すと、ワークフローはキャンセルされ、カードで押さえていた与信を取り消す。
on cancel
  match 決済.status
    none => pass
    requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, requires_capture =>
      決済 <- 与信を取り消す(intent: 決済.id)
        on 状態の不一致 => fail 取消の失敗 "Stripe が与信の取消を拒否しました。売上が確定しているかもしれません。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "与信を取り消せませんでした。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済
    processing => fail 確定の結果不明 "売上の確定の途中でキャンセルされました。担当者に引き渡します" leaving 決済

workflow inquiry v1
description "Jev picks the kind of a customer's inquiry and says how sure it is; an agent reads the inquiry for an order number and its point, and for its kind too, which the flow takes when Jev is not sure enough of its own. A rule decides the desk that takes it and how soon it is answered; another agent drafts the first reply; and a ticket goes into the desk's system. Jev picks, agents read and write (OpenAI's reads, Claude writes), and the rule decides. Written for AWS, for Step Functions and Lambda durable functions: the rule is a Lambda function, and Step Functions calls Jev, the agents and the desk's HTTP API through EventBridge connections, which hold the keys. The other platforms run it too, with the calls dandori writes for each"

use rule routing from "../rules/inquiry_routing.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:inquiry-routing"

record Inquiry
  id     : string
  member : bool
  text   : string

record Reading
  kind     : routing.kind
  order_id : string?
  point    : string

record Ticket
  ticket_id : string

inputs
  inquiry : Inquiry

outputs
  ticket_id : string
  desk      : routing.desk

# Jev picks one of the rule's kinds, knowing what each means, and says how sure it is.
task pick_kind(text: string) -> routing.kind
  jev "Which kind of inquiry is this?"
    returns "The customer wants to send an item back or exchange it"
    delivery "A parcel is late, lost or damaged, or the customer asks where it is"
    billing "A charge, an invoice, a payment or a refund"
    other "None of the above"
  model "jev-1.13.0"
  confidence 0.8 else unsure
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/typesafe/8b9c0d1e"
  timeout 10 seconds
  retry 2 times every 1 second

# The model reads the text; the schema of Reading holds its answer to one of the rule's kinds.
task read_inquiry(text: string) -> Reading
  agent "Read the text of a customer's inquiry, choose its kind, take out the order number if one is written, and sum up its point in one sentence. If no order number is written, give null."
  model "gpt-5.4-mini"
  effort low
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/openai/5e6f7a8b"
  timeout 60 seconds
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds

task draft_reply(kind: routing.kind, point: string, order_id: string?, within: duration[h]) -> string
  agent claude "Draft the first reply to the inquiry, politely, in three sentences at most. `within` is the number of hours before the reply is due. Promise nothing that cannot be kept."
  model "claude-sonnet-5"
  effort medium
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/claude/6f7a8b9c"
  timeout 60 seconds

task file_ticket(inquiry_id: string, desk: routing.desk, within: duration[h], subject: string, text: string, draft: string?) -> Ticket
  http POST "https://helpdesk.example.com/v1/tickets"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/helpdesk/7a8b9c0d"
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  let reading = read_inquiry(text: inquiry.text)
    on failure =>
      let by_hand = file_ticket(inquiry_id: inquiry.id, desk: general, within: 24, subject: "An inquiry that could not be read", text: inquiry.text, draft: none)
      succeed ticket_id = by_hand.ticket_id, desk = general
  # Jev's kind, when it is sure of it; when it is not, or cannot be reached, the agent's
  let kind = pick_kind(text: inquiry.text)
    on unsure, failure => let kind = reading.kind
  let decision = routing(kind: kind, member: inquiry.member)
  let subject = "An inquiry about {kind}"
  match reading.order_id
    some order_id => let subject = "An inquiry about {kind} (order {order_id})"
    none => pass
  let draft = draft_reply(kind: kind, point: reading.point, order_id: reading.order_id, within: decision.within)
    on failure => let draft: string? = none
  let t = file_ticket(inquiry_id: inquiry.id, desk: decision.desk, within: decision.within, subject: subject, text: inquiry.text, draft: draft)
  succeed ticket_id = t.ticket_id, desk = decision.desk

workflow 問い合わせ v1
description "お客さまの問い合わせの種類を Jev が選び、その確信度も返す。エージェントは問い合わせを読んで注文番号と要点を取り出し、種類も読む。Jev が種類に十分な確信を持てないときは、エージェントが読んだ種類を使う。受け持つ窓口と最初の返事までの時間は規則が決め、返事の下書きは別のエージェントが書き、窓口のシステムに起票する。選ぶことは Jev が、読むことと書くことはエージェント（読むのは OpenAI のモデル、書くのは Claude）が、決めることは規則が受け持つ。AWS 向けの版（Step Functions と Lambda durable functions）：規則は Lambda 関数で、Step Functions は Jev とエージェントと窓口の HTTP の API を、鍵を持つ EventBridge の接続を通して呼ぶ。ほかのプラットフォームでも、dandori がそれぞれ向けに生成する呼び出しで動く"

use rule 振り分け from "../rules/問い合わせの振り分け.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:inquiry-routing"

record 問い合わせ
  id   : string
  会員 : bool
  本文 : string

record 読み取り
  種類   : 振り分け.種類
  注文ID : string?
  要点   : string

record 起票
  チケットID : string

inputs
  問い合わせ : 問い合わせ

outputs
  チケットID : string
  窓口       : 振り分け.窓口

# Jev は規則の種類のどれかを、それぞれの意味を見て選び、その確信度も返す。
task 種類を選ぶ(本文: string) -> 振り分け.種類
  jev "この問い合わせの種類はどれか"
    返品 "商品を返したい、交換したい"
    配送 "荷物が遅れている、届かない、壊れていた、どこにあるか知りたい"
    請求 "請求、支払い、返金のこと"
    その他 "上のどれでもない"
  model "jev-1.13.0"
  confidence 0.8 else 迷い
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/typesafe/8b9c0d1e"
  timeout 10 seconds
  retry 2 times every 1 second

# モデルが本文を読む。読み取りの Schema が、答えを規則の種類のどれかに縛る。
task 読み取る(本文: string) -> 読み取り
  agent "お客さまからの問い合わせの本文を読み、種類を一つ選び、注文番号が書かれていれば取り出し、要点を一文にまとめてください。注文番号が書かれていなければ null にします。"
  model "gpt-5.4-mini"
  effort low
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/openai/5e6f7a8b"
  timeout 60 seconds
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds

task 下書きする(種類: 振り分け.種類, 要点: string, 注文ID: string?, 期限: duration[h]) -> string
  agent claude "問い合わせへの最初の返事を、丁寧な日本語で三文以内に下書きしてください。`期限` は返事をするまでの時間の数です。約束できないことは書きません。"
  model "claude-sonnet-5"
  effort medium
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/claude/6f7a8b9c"
  timeout 60 seconds

task 起票する(問い合わせID: string, 窓口: 振り分け.窓口, 期限: duration[h], 件名: string, 本文: string, 下書き: string?) -> 起票
  http POST "https://helpdesk.example.com/v1/tickets"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/helpdesk/7a8b9c0d"
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  let 読み = 読み取る(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on failure =>
      let 手作業 = 起票する(問い合わせID: 問い合わせ.id, 窓口: 総合, 期限: 24, 件名: "読み取れなかった問い合わせ", 本文: 問い合わせ.本文, 下書き: none)
      succeed チケットID = 手作業.チケットID, 窓口 = 総合
  # Jev が確信を持てた種類を使い、持てないときや届かないときは、エージェントが読んだ種類を使う
  let 種類 = 種類を選ぶ(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on 迷い, failure => let 種類 = 読み.種類
  let 判定 = 振り分け(種類: 種類, 会員: 問い合わせ.会員)
  let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ"
  match 読み.注文ID
    some 注文ID => let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ（注文 {注文ID}）"
    none => pass
  let 下書き = 下書きする(種類: 種類, 要点: 読み.要点, 注文ID: 読み.注文ID, 期限: 判定.期限)
    on failure => let 下書き: string? = none
  let 票 = 起票する(問い合わせID: 問い合わせ.id, 窓口: 判定.窓口, 期限: 判定.期限, 件名: 件名, 本文: 問い合わせ.本文, 下書き: 下書き)
  succeed チケットID = 票.チケットID, 窓口 = 判定.窓口

  agent "お客さまからの問い合わせの本文を読み、種類を一つ選び、注文番号が書かれていれば取り出し、要点を一文にまとめてください。注文番号が書かれていなければ null にします。"
  model "gpt-5.4-mini"
  effort low
  timeout 60 seconds
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds

task 下書きする(種類: 振り分け.種類, 要点: string, 注文ID: string?, 期限: duration[h]) -> string
  agent claude "問い合わせへの最初の返事を、丁寧な日本語で三文以内に下書きしてください。`期限` は返事をするまでの時間の数です。約束できないことは書きません。"
  model "claude-sonnet-5"
  effort medium
  timeout 60 seconds

# 起票は、窓口のシステムのクライアントライブラリを使って、自分で書くコードで行う。
task 起票する(問い合わせID: string, 窓口: 振り分け.窓口, 期限: duration[h], 件名: string, 本文: string, 下書き: string?) -> 起票
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  let 読み = 読み取る(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on failure =>
      let 手作業 = 起票する(問い合わせID: 問い合わせ.id, 窓口: 総合, 期限: 24, 件名: "読み取れなかった問い合わせ", 本文: 問い合わせ.本文, 下書き: none)
      succeed チケットID = 手作業.チケットID, 窓口 = 総合
  # Jev が確信を持てた種類を使い、持てないときや届かないときは、エージェントが読んだ種類を使う
  let 種類 = 種類を選ぶ(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on 迷い, failure => let 種類 = 読み.種類
  let 判定 = 振り分け(種類: 種類, 会員: 問い合わせ.会員)
  let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ"
  match 読み.注文ID
    some 注文ID => let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ（注文 {注文ID}）"
    none => pass
  let 下書き = 下書きする(種類: 種類, 要点: 読み.要点, 注文ID: 読み.注文ID, 期限: 判定.期限)
    on failure => let 下書き: string? = none
  let 票 = 起票する(問い合わせID: 問い合わせ.id, 窓口: 判定.窓口, 期限: 判定.期限, 件名: 件名, 本文: 問い合わせ.本文, 下書き: 下書き)
  succeed チケットID = 票.チケットID, 窓口 = 判定.窓口

texts.crates/dandori/examples/inquiry/temporal:
workflow inquiry v1
description "Jev picks the kind of a customer's inquiry and says how sure it is; an agent reads the inquiry for an order number and its point, and for its kind too, which the flow takes when Jev is not sure enough of its own. A rule decides the desk that takes it and how soon it is answered; another agent drafts the first reply; and a ticket goes into the desk's system. Jev picks, agents read and write (a model the company runs itself reads, Claude writes), and the rule decides. Written for Temporal: Jev and the agents are activities dandori writes, Jev called with TypeSafe's key (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), the reading sent to the company's Ollama, which serves Open Responses (`url`), and the draft to Claude with the key the worker has; the rule runs in the worker of the workflow as a local activity, its answer kept in the history as a marker; and filing the ticket is an activity you write"

use rule routing from "../rules/inquiry_routing.rule"
  local

record Inquiry
  id     : string
  member : bool
  text   : string

record Reading
  kind     : routing.kind
  order_id : string?
  point    : string

record Ticket
  ticket_id : string

inputs
  inquiry : Inquiry

outputs
  ticket_id : string
  desk      : routing.desk

# Jev picks one of the rule's kinds, knowing what each means, and says how sure it is.
task pick_kind(text: string) -> routing.kind
  jev "Which kind of inquiry is this?"
    returns "The customer wants to send an item back or exchange it"
    delivery "A parcel is late, lost or damaged, or the customer asks where it is"
    billing "A charge, an invoice, a payment or a refund"
    other "None of the above"
  model "jev-1.13.0"
  confidence 0.8 else unsure
  timeout 10 seconds
  retry 2 times every 1 second

# A model on the company's own Ollama reads the text, through Open Responses; the schema of
# Reading holds its answer to one of the rule's kinds.
task read_inquiry(text: string) -> Reading
  agent "Read the text of a customer's inquiry, choose its kind, take out the order number if one is written, and sum up its point in one sentence. If no order number is written, give null."
  model "gpt-oss:20b"
  effort low
  url "http://ollama.internal:11434/v1"
  plaintext "The model server is reached only inside the cluster network, which the service mesh encrypts"
  timeout 60 seconds
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds

task draft_reply(kind: routing.kind, point: string, order_id: string?, within: duration[h]) -> string
  agent claude "Draft the first reply to the inquiry, politely, in three sentences at most. `within` is the number of hours before the reply is due. Promise nothing that cannot be kept."
  model "claude-sonnet-5"
  effort medium
  timeout 60 seconds

# The ticket goes into the desk's system through its client library, in code you write.
task file_ticket(inquiry_id: string, desk: routing.desk, within: duration[h], subject: string, text: string, draft: string?) -> Ticket
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

flow
  let reading = read_inquiry(text: inquiry.text)
    on failure =>
      let by_hand = file_ticket(inquiry_id: inquiry.id, desk: general, within: 24, subject: "An inquiry that could not be read", text: inquiry.text, draft: none)
      succeed ticket_id = by_hand.ticket_id, desk = general
  # Jev's kind, when it is sure of it; when it is not, or cannot be reached, the agent's
  let kind = pick_kind(text: inquiry.text)
    on unsure, failure => let kind = reading.kind
  let decision = routing(kind: kind, member: inquiry.member)
  let subject = "An inquiry about {kind}"
  match reading.order_id
    some order_id => let subject = "An inquiry about {kind} (order {order_id})"
    none => pass
  let draft = draft_reply(kind: kind, point: reading.point, order_id: reading.order_id, within: decision.within)
    on failure => let draft: string? = none
  let t = file_ticket(inquiry_id: inquiry.id, desk: decision.desk, within: decision.within, subject: subject, text: inquiry.text, draft: draft)
  succeed ticket_id = t.ticket_id, desk = decision.desk

workflow 問い合わせ v1
description "お客さまの問い合わせの種類を Jev が選び、その確信度も返す。エージェントは問い合わせを読んで注文番号と要点を取り出し、種類も読む。Jev が種類に十分な確信を持てないときは、エージェントが読んだ種類を使う。受け持つ窓口と最初の返事までの時間は規則が決め、返事の下書きは別のエージェントが書き、窓口のシステムに起票する。選ぶことは Jev が、読むことと書くことはエージェント（読むのは会社が自分で動かしているモデル、書くのは Claude）が、決めることは規則が受け持つ。Temporal 向けの版：Jev とエージェントは生成したアクティビティで、Jev は TypeSafe の API キー（TYPESAFE_API_KEY）で呼び、読み取りは Open Responses を話す会社の Ollama に（`url`）、下書きはワーカーが持つ鍵で Claude に送る。規則はワークフローと同じワーカーでローカルアクティビティとして動き、その結果はマーカーとして履歴に残る。起票は自分で書くアクティビティ"

  model "gpt-oss:20b"
  effort low
