  plaintext "モデルのサーバーにはクラスターのネットワークの中だけで届き、そこはサービスメッシュが暗号化する"
  timeout 60 seconds
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds

  agent claude "問い合わせへの最初の返事を、丁寧な日本語で三文以内に下書きしてください。`期限` は返事をするまでの時間の数です。約束できないことは書きません。"
  model "claude-sonnet-5"
  effort medium
  timeout 60 seconds

# 起票は、窓口のシステムのクライアントライブラリを使って、自分で書くコードで行う。
task 起票する(問い合わせID: string, 窓口: 振り分け.窓口, 期限: duration[h], 件名: string, 本文: string, 下書き: string?) -> 起票

  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

  let 読み = 読み取る(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on failure =>
      let 手作業 = 起票する(問い合わせID: 問い合わせ.id, 窓口: 総合, 期限: 24, 件名: "読み取れなかった問い合わせ", 本文: 問い合わせ.本文, 下書き: none)
      succeed チケットID = 手作業.チケットID, 窓口 = 総合
  # Jev が確信を持てた種類を使い、持てないときや届かないときは、エージェントが読んだ種類を使う
  let 種類 = 種類を選ぶ(本文: 問い合わせ.本文)
    on 迷い, failure => let 種類 = 読み.種類
  let 判定 = 振り分け(種類: 種類, 会員: 問い合わせ.会員)
  let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ"
  match 読み.注文ID
    some 注文ID => let 件名 = "{種類}の問い合わせ（注文 {注文ID}）"
    none => pass
  let 下書き = 下書きする(種類: 種類, 要点: 読み.要点, 注文ID: 読み.注文ID, 期限: 判定.期限)

# An order holds its goods in stock until its payment is due, by the payment terms counted from the
# moment the order came in; paid, the goods ship, and unpaid, they go back on the shelves. The stock
# is a book of chobo's, and the due date a date of koyomi's. It runs on every platform.
workflow invoice v1
description "An order holds its goods until its payment is due, then ships them once paid, or puts them back"

use dates terms from "dates/payment_terms.cal"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-2:123456789012:function:payment-terms"
use book stock from "books/stock.book"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-2:123456789012:function:stock"

record Order
  id       : string
  sku      : string
  quantity : int  range >=1 <=100

record Payment
  paid : bool

enum Outcome = shipped | not_paid | out_of_stock

inputs
  order : Order

outputs
  outcome : Outcome
  due     : date?

# The book holds the goods for the order: chobo's client runs the hold, and a refusal comes back
# with the reason the book gives it.
task reserve(order: string, sku: string, qty: int) -> stock.reserve
  book stock.reserve.hold
  starts stock.reserve
  errors out_of_stock

task ship(order: string, sku: string) -> stock.reserve
  book stock.reserve.post
  sends post
  errors expired

task put_back(order: string, sku: string) -> stock.reserve
  book stock.reserve.void
  sends void
  errors expired, already_posted

task check_payment(order: string, due: date) -> Payment
  http GET "https://payments.example.com/orders/{order}/payment"
  connection "arn:aws:events:eu-west-2:123456789012:connection/payments/1a2b3c"
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds
  idempotent

# The hold expires on its own after 60 days, as the book says: the checker counts that too.
case hold : stock.reserve follows stock.reserve

flow
  hold <- reserve(order: order.id, sku: order.sku, qty: order.quantity)
    on out_of_stock => succeed outcome = out_of_stock, due = none
  let due = terms.payment(received: now)
  wait until due.at
  let payment = check_payment(order: order.id, due: due.day)
  match payment.paid
    true =>
      hold <- ship(order: order.id, sku: order.sku)
        on expired => succeed outcome = not_paid, due = due.day
      succeed outcome = shipped, due = due.day
    false =>
      hold <- put_back(order: order.id, sku: order.sku)
        on expired => pass
      succeed outcome = not_paid, due = due.day

on failure
  match hold.state
    none => pass
    held =>
      hold <- put_back(order: order.id, sku: order.sku)
        on expired => pass
        on already_posted => pass
        on failure => fail NotPutBack "the goods held for the order could not be put back" leaving hold

# 注文の品を、支払期日まで在庫から押さえる。期日は、注文を受けた時刻から支払条件で数える。支払われ
# たら出荷し、支払われなければ棚に戻す。在庫は chobo の帳簿、期日は koyomi の日付。どのプラットフォ
# ームでも動く。
workflow 請求 v1
description "注文の品を支払期日まで押さえ、支払われたら出荷し、支払われなければ戻す"

use dates 支払条件 from "dates/支払条件.cal"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:payment-terms"
use book 在庫 from "books/在庫.book"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:stock"

record 注文
  id  : string
  sku : string
  数  : int  range >=1 <=100

record 支払
  済み : bool

enum 終わり方 = 出荷済 | 未払い | 在庫切れ

inputs
  受注 : 注文

outputs
  結果 : 終わり方
  期日 : date?

# 帳簿が注文のために品を押さえる。押さえるのは chobo のクライアントで、拒否されると、帳簿が付けた
# 理由で返ってくる。
task 引き当てる(注文: string, sku: string, 数: int) -> 在庫.引当
  book 在庫.引当.hold
  starts 在庫.引当
  errors 在庫切れ

task 出荷する(注文: string, sku: string) -> 在庫.引当
  book 在庫.引当.post
  sends post
  errors expired

task 戻す(注文: string, sku: string) -> 在庫.引当
  book 在庫.引当.void
  sends void
  errors expired, already_posted

task 支払を確かめる(注文: string, 期日: date) -> 支払
  http GET "https://payments.example.com/orders/{注文}/payment"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/payments/1a2b3c"
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds
  idempotent

# 押さえは、帳簿のとおり 60 日たつと勝手に期限が切れる。検査はそれも数える。
case 押さえ : 在庫.引当 follows 在庫.引当

flow
  押さえ <- 引き当てる(注文: 受注.id, sku: 受注.sku, 数: 受注.数)
    on 在庫切れ => succeed 結果 = 在庫切れ, 期日 = none
  let 期限 = 支払条件.支払日(受領日: now)
  wait until 期限.at
  let 入金 = 支払を確かめる(注文: 受注.id, 期日: 期限.day)
  match 入金.済み
    true =>
      押さえ <- 出荷する(注文: 受注.id, sku: 受注.sku)
        on expired => succeed 結果 = 未払い, 期日 = 期限.day
      succeed 結果 = 出荷済, 期日 = 期限.day
    false =>
      押さえ <- 戻す(注文: 受注.id, sku: 受注.sku)
        on expired => pass
      succeed 結果 = 未払い, 期日 = 期限.day

on failure
  match 押さえ.state
    none => pass
    held =>
      押さえ <- 戻す(注文: 受注.id, sku: 受注.sku)
        on expired => pass
        on already_posted => pass
        on failure => fail 戻せない "注文のために押さえた品を戻せませんでした" leaving 押さえ
workflow ship_order v1
description "For an order in the warehouse's system, ask for the payment, have it shipped, and wait for word of the delivery. The warehouse's system keeps the order's state, which moves as rulec's rule order_state says. Written for AWS, for Step Functions and Lambda durable functions: the urgency rule is called at its Connect service (the one `rulec gen` writes for it), the notice is a Lambda function, the calls of the warehouse and of the rule go through EventBridge connections, and the word of the delivery comes back by the task token a Lambda function keeps. The other platforms run it too, with the calls dandori writes for each"

use rule order_state from "../rules/order_state.rule"
use rule urgency from "../rules/urgency.rule"
  connect "https://rules.example.com"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/rules/5e6f7a"

record Order
  id     : string
  state  : order_state.state
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  member : bool

record Receipt
  id : string

inputs
  order_id : string

outputs
  carrier : urgency.carrier

task get_order(id: string, expand: string) -> Order
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors busy = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on busy

task request_shipment(id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  sends ship
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

task request_cancel(id: string) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/warehouse/1f2e3d"
  sends cancel
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

task notify(order_id: string, text: string) -> Receipt
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:notify"
  errors no_recipient
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# The warehouse calls back when the carrier reports the delivery.
task wait_for_delivery(id: string) -> Order
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:delivery-inbox"
  callback
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case order : Order follows order_state.order
  external pay, deliver, cancel
  refused when accepted = false

flow
  order <- get_order(id: order_id, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match order.state
      received =>
        let r = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "We are waiting for your payment")
          on no_recipient => fail NoContact leaving order
        wait 1 day
        order <- get_order(id: order.id, expand: "items")
      paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled => break
  match order.state
    received =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => pass
      fail NotPaid "No payment came in three days"
    cancelled => fail Canceled "The order was canceled"
    shipped, delivered => fail AlreadyShipped "The order has shipped already" leaving order
    paid => pass
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  order <- request_shipment(id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier)
    on conflict => fail Canceled "The order was canceled before it shipped"
  match decision.urgent
    true => let n = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Shipped by next-day delivery")
    false => pass
  order <- wait_for_delivery(id: order.id)
    on timeout => fail DeliveryLate "No word of the delivery in seven days" leaving order
  match order.state
    delivered => succeed carrier = decision.carrier
    shipped => fail DeliveryLate "Still shipped after word of the delivery" leaving order

on failure
  fail Stopped "Stopped on the way; the order stays in the warehouse's system as it is" leaving order

  repeat at most 3 times

    出荷済, 配達済 => fail 既に出荷 "もう出荷されています" leaving 受注

  match 受注.状態
    配達済 => succeed 便 = 判定.便
    出荷済 => fail 配達の遅れ "配達の知らせのあとも出荷済のままです" leaving 受注

on failure
  fail 中断 "途中で止まりました。注文は倉庫のシステムにそのまま残ります" leaving 受注

rule order_state v1
description "Where an online order goes on a payment, a shipment, a delivery or a request to cancel it, and how much is refunded. The caller keeps the state; the rule decides one event at a time. Written for the example"

enum state = received | paid | shipped | delivered | cancelled
enum event = pay | ship | deliver | cancel

inputs
  state       : state
  event       : event
  amount_paid : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0JPY <=1000000JPY

outputs
  next_state : state
  refund     : money[JPY, incl_tax]  round down(1JPY)
  accepted   : bool

table step
policy unique
| state     | event             | -> next_state | refund      | accepted |
| received  | pay               | paid          | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | cancel            | cancelled     | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | ship, deliver     | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| paid      | ship              | shipped       | 0JPY        | true     |
| paid      | cancel            | cancelled     | amount_paid | true     |
| paid      | pay, deliver      | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| shipped   | deliver           | delivered     | 0JPY        | true     |
| shipped   | pay, ship, cancel | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a cancel after the shipment goes through a return
| delivered | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| cancelled | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a payment that comes after a cancel does not bring the order back

machine order over step
  carry   state -> next_state
  held    amount_paid
  initial received
  final   delivered, cancelled
  never   shipped after cancelled
  once    refund >0JPY

scenario delivered
| event   | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| pay     | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY   | true     |
| ship    | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | true     |
| deliver | 3000JPY     | delivered     | 0JPY   | true     |

scenario late_pay
| event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund  | accepted |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY    | true     |
| cancel | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 3000JPY | true     |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 0JPY    | false    |

examples
| state    | event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| received | cancel | 0JPY        | cancelled     | 0JPY   | true     |
| shipped  | cancel | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | false    |

rule 注文の状態(order_state) v1
description "通販の注文が、入金・出荷・配達・取消依頼のイベントでどの状態に移り、いくら返金するか。状態は呼び出す側が持ち、規則は一回のイベントだけを判定する。書き下ろしの例"

enum 状態(state) = 受付(received) | 入金済(paid) | 出荷済(shipped) | 配達済(delivered) | 取消(cancelled)
enum イベント(event) = 入金(pay) | 出荷(ship) | 配達(deliver) | 取消依頼(cancel)

inputs
  状態(state)     : 状態
  イベント(event) : イベント
  支払額(paid)    : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円

outputs
  次の状態(next_state) : 状態
  返金額(refund)       : money[円, incl_tax]  round down(1円)
  受理(accepted)       : bool

workflow ship_order v1
description "For an order in the warehouse's system, ask for the payment, have it shipped, and wait for word of the delivery. The warehouse's system keeps the order's state, which moves as rulec's rule order_state says. Written for Temporal: the warehouse's calls are activities dandori writes, and the notice is an activity you write; the carrier's system tells the workflow of the order about the delivery, by the order's id (an event); and an order the shop cancels on the way is cancelled at the warehouse too (on cancel). The loop over the reminders goes on in a new run when its history grows long"

use rule order_state from "../rules/order_state.rule"
use rule urgency from "../rules/urgency.rule"

record Order
  id     : string
  state  : order_state.state
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  member : bool

record Receipt
  id : string

inputs
  order_id : string

outputs
  carrier : urgency.carrier

task get_order(id: string, expand: string) -> Order
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors busy = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on busy

task request_shipment(id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends ship
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

task request_cancel(id: string) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends cancel
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

# The shop's own notice service, called from code you write.
task notify(order_id: string, text: string) -> Receipt
  errors no_recipient
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# The carrier's system sends the order as the warehouse has it now to the workflow of the
# order when the carrier reports the delivery.
task delivered() -> Order
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case order : Order follows order_state.order
  external pay, deliver, cancel
  refused when accepted = false

flow
  order <- get_order(id: order_id, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match order.state
      received =>
        let r = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "We are waiting for your payment")
          on no_recipient => fail NoContact leaving order
        wait 1 day
        order <- get_order(id: order.id, expand: "items")
      paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled => break
  match order.state
    received =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => pass
      fail NotPaid "No payment came in three days"
    cancelled => fail Canceled "The order was canceled"
    shipped, delivered => fail AlreadyShipped "The order has shipped already" leaving order
    paid => pass
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  order <- request_shipment(id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier)
    on conflict => fail Canceled "The order was canceled before it shipped"
  match decision.urgent
    true => let n = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Shipped by next-day delivery")
    false => pass
  order <- delivered()
    on timeout => fail DeliveryLate "No word of the delivery in seven days" leaving order
  match order.state
    delivered => succeed carrier = decision.carrier
    shipped => fail DeliveryLate "Still shipped after word of the delivery" leaving order

on failure
  fail Stopped "Stopped on the way; the order stays in the warehouse's system as it is" leaving order

# The shop cancels the order on the way: the workflow is cancelled, and the warehouse is asked to
# cancel the order too, unless it has gone out.
on cancel
  match order.state
    none => pass
    received, paid =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => fail ShippedAlready "The warehouse refused to cancel order {order.id}; it may have shipped" leaving order
        on failure => fail CancelFailed "Could not cancel order {order.id} at the warehouse" leaving order
    shipped => fail ShippedAlready "Order {order.id} has shipped already" leaving order

workflow 出荷 v1
description "倉庫のシステムにある注文について、入金を催促し、出荷させ、配達の知らせを待つ。注文の状態は倉庫のシステムが持ち、その移り方は rulec の規則「注文の状態」に従う。Temporal 向けの版：倉庫の呼び出しは dandori が生成するアクティビティで、お知らせは自分で書くアクティビティ。配達のことは、運送会社のシステムが注文の ID を宛先にして知らせる（event）。お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、倉庫でも取り消す（on cancel）。催促のループは、履歴が長くなると新しい実行に引き継ぐ"

use rule 注文の状態 from "../rules/注文の状態.rule"
use rule 急ぎ from "../rules/出荷の急ぎ.rule"

record 注文
  id   : string
  状態 : 注文の状態.状態
  金額 : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  会員 : bool

record 受付
  id : string

inputs
  注文ID : string

outputs
  便 : 急ぎ.便

task 注文を見る(id: string, expand: string) -> 注文
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors 混雑 = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on 混雑

task 出荷を頼む(id: string, 便: 急ぎ.便) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends 出荷
  errors 拒否された = 409
  refused as 拒否された
  key

task 取消を頼む(id: string) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends 取消依頼
  errors 拒否された = 409
  refused as 拒否された
  key

# お店の通知サービス。自分で書くコードから呼ぶ。
task 知らせる(注文ID: string, 本文: string) -> 受付
  errors 宛先なし
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# 運送会社のシステムは、配達を報告したとき、倉庫にあるそのときの注文を、注文のワークフローに送る。
task 配達の知らせ() -> 注文
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case 受注 : 注文 follows 注文の状態.注文
  external 入金, 配達, 取消依頼
  refused when 受理 = false

flow
  受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 注文ID, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match 受注.状態
      受付 =>
        let 催促の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "お支払いをお待ちしています")
          on 宛先なし => fail 連絡先なし leaving 受注
        wait 1 day
        受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 受注.id, expand: "items")
      入金済, 出荷済, 配達済, 取消 => break
  match 受注.状態
    受付 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 拒否された => pass
      fail 未入金 "三日たっても入金がありませんでした"
    取消 => fail 取消済み "取り消された注文です"
    出荷済, 配達済 => fail 既に出荷 "もう出荷されています" leaving 受注
    入金済 => pass
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 受注.会員, 金額: 受注.金額)
  受注 <- 出荷を頼む(id: 受注.id, 便: 判定.便)
    on 拒否された => fail 取消済み "出荷の前に取り消されました"
  match 判定.急ぎ
    true => let 出荷の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "翌日便で出荷しました")
    false => pass
  受注 <- 配達の知らせ()
    on timeout => fail 配達の遅れ "七日たっても配達の知らせがありません" leaving 受注
  match 受注.状態
    配達済 => succeed 便 = 判定.便
    出荷済 => fail 配達の遅れ "配達の知らせのあとも出荷済のままです" leaving 受注

on failure
  fail 中断 "途中で止まりました。注文は倉庫のシステムにそのまま残ります" leaving 受注

# お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、ワークフローはキャンセルされ、まだ出荷していなければ倉庫にも取消を頼む。
on cancel
  match 受注.状態
    none => pass
    受付, 入金済 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 拒否された => fail 出荷後の取消 "倉庫が注文 {受注.id} の取消を拒否しました。出荷されたのかもしれません" leaving 受注
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "倉庫で注文 {受注.id} を取り消せませんでした" leaving 受注
    出荷済 => fail 出荷後の取消 "注文 {受注.id} はもう出荷されています" leaving 受注

workflow payout v1
description "Pay a seller what their sales came to: the bank's API pays the account the seller keeps on file, and a model drafts the notice. The flow carries the account's id, and never its number or the name it is held in, which the bank's contract marks secret"

use proto bank from "specs/payout.proto"
  url "https://bank.example.com"

inputs
  seller_id  : string
  account_id : string
  amount     : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=1 <=10000000

outputs
  payout_id : string

# The bank pays the account it holds the number of; the flow names it by its id.
task pay(account_id: string, amount: money[JPY, incl_tax], reference: string) -> bank.PayResponse
  connect bank "PayoutService/Pay"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/bank/7c1e2d"
  key
  errors refused = failed_precondition

# The model reads the amount and the payout's id, and nothing of the account.
task draft_notice(amount: money[JPY, incl_tax], payout_id: string) -> string
  agent "Draft a short notice to the seller that their payout was sent, with its amount in yen and its id. Say nothing of the account."
  model "gpt-5.4-mini"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/openai/3f2a1b"
  timeout 60 seconds

task send_notice(seller_id: string, text: string)
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:send-notice"
  idempotent

flow
  let paid = pay(account_id: account_id, amount: amount, reference: "Sales payout")
    on refused => fail Refused "the bank refused the payout to the account {account_id}"
  let notice = draft_notice(amount: amount, payout_id: paid.payoutId)
  send_notice(seller_id: seller_id, text: notice)
  succeed payout_id = paid.payoutId

description "売り手に売上を支払う。銀行の API が、売り手が登録している口座に送金し、モデルが知らせを下書きする。フローが運ぶのは口座の ID だけで、銀行の契約が秘密と印を付けた番号と名義は運ばない"

use proto 銀行 from "specs/payout.ja.proto"

inputs
  売り手ID : string

outputs

# 銀行は、番号を持っている口座に送金する。フローは口座を ID で指す。
task 送金する(口座ID: string, 金額: money[円, incl_tax], 摘要: string) -> 銀行.PayResponse

  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/bank/7c1e2d"

  agent "売り手に、売上の送金を済ませたことを知らせる短い文面を下書きしてください。金額（円）と送金の ID を書き、口座のことは書かないでください。"

  let 知らせ = 知らせを書く(金額: 金額, 送金ID: 送金.送金ID)
  知らせる(売り手ID: 売り手ID, 本文: 知らせ)
  succeed 送金ID = 送金.送金ID
texts.crates/dandori/examples/review/argo/revi:
workflow review v1
description "Jev scores an application and says how sure it is, and a rule decides whether the verdict is acted on at once or goes to a person for approval: approving at once asks more certainty than rejecting at once. Written for Argo Workflows: the scoring and the rule run in a container of the image dandori writes (`caller/`), which calls Jev with TypeSafe's key; asking for the approval and the notice are containers of your images, and the approver's tool answers the callback with `argo node set` and `argo resume`"

use rule policy from "../rules/review_policy.rule"

record Application
  id      : string
  amount  : int
  purpose : string

record Score
  verdict : policy.verdict
  sure    : rate[step 1%]  range >=0 <=100

record Approval
  approver : string

inputs
  application : Application

outputs
  verdict : policy.verdict

# Jev places what the applicant wrote on the scale of verdicts, from the lowest level, and how
# sure it is of the verdict comes as a rate, for the rule to weigh.
task score(purpose: string) -> Score
  jev
    verdict score "How clearly is the money for running the business?"
      reject "It is for something personal or speculative, or against the law"
      hold "It is for the business, but the statement leaves unclear what it pays for"
      approve "It pays for a named part of running the business, such as stock, equipment, staff or premises"
    sure confidence of verdict
  model "jev-1.13.0"
  errors busy = 429, overloaded = 529
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds on busy, overloaded
  timeout 10 seconds

# The other tasks run in a container of their image, which reads the call from DANDORI_CALL.
# Someone approves in a tool of their own, and the answer comes back with the callback's id.
task ask_for_approval(application_id: string, amount: int, sure: rate[step 1%]) -> Approval
  image "registry.example.com/review/approval:1"
  callback
  timeout 3 days

task notify(application_id: string, text: string)
  image "registry.example.com/review/notify:1"
  idempotent

flow
  let r = score(purpose: application.purpose)
    on failure => fail Unscorable "Could not score application {application.id}"
  let d = policy(verdict: r.verdict, sure: r.sure)
  match d.decision
    approve, reject => pass
    ask =>
      let a = ask_for_approval(application_id: application.id, amount: application.amount, sure: r.sure)
        on timeout => fail NoAnswer "No approval in three days"
      notify(application_id: application.id, text: "{a.approver} approved application {application.id}")
      succeed verdict = approve
  notify(application_id: application.id, text: "Application {application.id} was reviewed: {r.verdict}")
  succeed verdict = r.verdict

workflow 審査 v1
description "Jev が申込を採点してその確信度も返し、その判断をそのまま実行するか、人の承認に回すかを規則が決める。そのまま承認するには、そのまま却下するより高い確信度が要る。Argo Workflows 向けの版：採点と規則は、生成したイメージ（`caller/`）のコンテナで動き、採点は TypeSafe の API キーで Jev を呼ぶ。承認を求めることとお知らせは自分のイメージのコンテナで、承認する人のツールは `argo node set` と `argo resume` でコールバックに応答する"

use rule 方針 from "../rules/審査の方針.rule"

record 申込
  id   : string
  金額 : int
  用途 : string

record 採点
  判断   : 方針.判断
  確信度 : rate[step 1%]  range >=0 <=100

record 承認
  承認者 : string

inputs
  申込 : 申込

outputs
  判断 : 方針.判断

# Jev は申込者が書いた用途を読み、判断の段階（低いほうから）のどこに当たるかと、その確信度を返す。
# 確信度は率で受け取り、規則が判断と一緒に見て決める。
task 採点する(用途: string) -> 採点
  jev
    判断 score "資金は、どれだけはっきり事業に使われるか"
      却下 "私用や投機、法に反することに使う"
      保留 "事業に使うが、何に払うのかがはっきりしない"
      承認 "仕入れ、設備、人件費、店舗など、事業のはっきりした費目に使う"
    確信度 confidence of 判断
  model "jev-1.13.0"
  errors 混雑 = 429, 過負荷 = 529
  retry 2 times every 10 seconds on 混雑, 過負荷
  timeout 10 seconds

# ほかのタスクは自分のイメージのコンテナで動き、呼び出しを DANDORI_CALL から読む。
# 承認する人が自分のツールで承認し、その結果がコールバックの ID と一緒に返ってくる。
task 承認を求める(申込ID: string, 金額: int, 確信度: rate[step 1%]) -> 承認
  image "registry.example.com/review/approval:1"
  callback
  timeout 3 days

task 知らせる(申込ID: string, 本文: string)
  image "registry.example.com/review/notify:1"
  idempotent

flow
  let 結果 = 採点する(用途: 申込.用途)
    on failure => fail 採点不能 "申込 {申込.id} を採点できませんでした"
  let 判定 = 方針(判断: 結果.判断, 確信度: 結果.確信度)
  match 判定.決定
    承認, 却下 => pass
    人に回す =>
      let 返事 = 承認を求める(申込ID: 申込.id, 金額: 申込.金額, 確信度: 結果.確信度)
        on timeout => fail 承認なし "三日たっても承認がありません"
      知らせる(申込ID: 申込.id, 本文: "{返事.承認者} さんが申込 {申込.id} を承認しました")
      succeed 判断 = 承認
  知らせる(申込ID: 申込.id, 本文: "申込 {申込.id} の審査が済みました: {結果.判断}")
  succeed 判断 = 結果.判断

workflow hotel_stay v1
description "When a stay is booked, hold an amount on the card, and capture it on the day of check-out. A rule decides the amount and whether the front desk looks first; the payment is a Stripe PaymentIntent"

use rule hold from "../../examples/hotel/rules/hold_amount.rule"
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:hold-amount"
use rule payment_intent from "../../examples/hotel/rules/payment_intent.rule"

record Booking
  id        : string
  room      : hold.room
  nights    : int
  card      : string
  check_out : timestamp

record PaymentIntent
  id     : string
  status : payment_intent.status

enum Outcome = stayed | awaiting_review

inputs
  booking : Booking

outputs
  outcome : Outcome

task create_intent(amount: money[JPY, incl_tax], currency: string, payment_method: string, capture_method: payment_intent.capture_method) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST "https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents" form
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  starts payment_intent.payment then attach
  key
  retry 2 times every 2 seconds

task confirm_intent(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST "https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/{id}/confirm" form
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends confirm
  errors card_declined = 402, unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task capture_intent(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST "https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/{id}/capture" form
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends capture
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

task cancel_intent(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http POST "https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/{id}/cancel" form
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  sends cancel
  errors unexpected_state = 400
  refused as unexpected_state
  key

task get_intent(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  http GET "https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents/{id}"
  connection "arn:aws:events:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:connection/stripe/0a1b2c3d"
  observes
  idempotent
  retry 3 times every 2 seconds

# The customer's 3-D Secure step: a Lambda function keeps the task token until Stripe's
# webhook says the PaymentIntent moved, and then hands it back with the PaymentIntent.
task wait_for_customer(id: string) -> PaymentIntent
  lambda "arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:123456789012:function:stripe-webhook-inbox"
  callback
  observes
  timeout 1 hour

case pi : PaymentIntent follows payment_intent.payment
  held capture_method = manual
  held confirmation_method = automatic
  external authenticate, settle, expire
  refused when refused = true

flow
  let quote = hold(room: booking.room, nights: booking.nights)
  match quote.handling
    review => succeed outcome = awaiting_review
    auto => pi <- create_intent(amount: quote.amount, currency: "jpy", payment_method: booking.card, capture_method: manual)
  pi <- confirm_intent(id: pi.id)
    on card_declined => pi <- get_intent(id: pi.id)
  match pi.status
    requires_action =>
      pi <- wait_for_customer(id: pi.id)
    requires_capture => wait until booking.check_out
    requires_payment_method => fail CardDeclined "The card was declined"
    canceled => fail PaymentCanceled "The PaymentIntent was canceled"
  pi <- capture_intent(id: pi.id)
    on unexpected_state => fail HoldExpired "The hold had expired"
  succeed outcome = stayed

rule parcel_rate v1
description "A parcel tariff in pounds and inches, written in English. A sketch, not a transcription: the amounts are made up"

# Nothing else in the corpus is priced in USD by weight, and nothing at all reached oz, lb
# or in — an unexercised unit is an unchecked unit (§15.9).

enum size_class = envelope | small | large
enum zone = domestic | canada | overseas

group north_america = domestic, canada

inputs
  weight    : mass[lb]    range >=1lb <=70lb
  girth     : length[in]  range >=1in <=130in
  dest      : zone
  signature : bool

outputs
  fee : money[USD, incl_tax]  round up(1USD)

# One table decides the class and the next one prices it: what the first produces is a
# column of the second.
table size_of
policy first
| girth  | -> size : size_class |
| <=22in | envelope             |
| <=60in | small                |
| -      | large                |

table base_rate
policy unique
| dest          | size     | weight  | -> base : money[USD, incl_tax] |
| north_america | envelope | -       | 6USD                           |
| north_america | small    | <=160oz | 12USD                          |
| north_america | small    | >160oz  | 18USD                          |
| north_america | large    | <=160oz | 22USD                          |
| north_america | large    | >160oz  | 30USD                          |
| overseas      | envelope | -       | 16USD                          |
| overseas      | small    | -       | 38USD                          |
| overseas      | large    | -       | 60USD                          |

# A fuel surcharge is a percentage of the base, which is what the rounding on the output is
# there to settle: 12USD at 5% is 12.60USD, and up(1USD) makes that 13USD.
table fuel_rate
policy unique
| dest          | -> fuel : rate[step 1%] |
| north_america | 5%                      |
| overseas      | 12%                     |

table signature_fee
policy unique
| signature | -> extra : money[USD, incl_tax] |
| true      | 4USD                            |
| false     | 0USD                            |

result fee = base + base × fuel + extra

examples
| weight | girth | dest     | signature | -> fee |
| 5lb    | 10in  | domestic | false     | 7USD   |
| 5lb    | 40in  | canada   | false     | 13USD  |
| 20lb   | 40in  | domestic | true      | 23USD  |
| 5lb    | 10in  | overseas | false     | 18USD  |

rule shipment_surcharge v1
description "A surcharge decided from the total weight of a shipment's cartons. A sketch, not a transcription: the amounts are made up"

# Every rule that walks a sequence was written in Japanese, so the elements/sum shape had
# never been read in English — its diagnostics and its generated code were exercised in one
# language only. Writing this one found a brand the generators never defined (DESIGN).

enum service = ground | express

inputs
  svc         : service
  residential : bool

# One carton. The caller passes as many as the shipment has.
elements cartons
  weight : mass[lb]  range >=1lb <=150lb

# What is left after the walk is the total. The range is the universe completeness is
# checked against, and it is also the door the caller is turned away at.
sum total over cartons of weight  range >=0lb <=2000lb

outputs
  surcharge : money[USD, incl_tax]  round up(1USD)

table surcharge_table
policy unique
| total   | svc     | residential | -> surcharge(surcharge) : money[USD, incl_tax] |
| <=150lb | ground  | false       | 0USD                                           |
| <=150lb | ground  | true        | 4USD                                           |
| <=150lb | express | -           | 12USD                                          |
| >150lb  | ground  | -           | 35USD                                          |
| >150lb  | express | -           | 60USD                                          |

examples
| cartons | svc     | residential | -> surcharge |
| two     | ground  | false       | 0USD         |
| two     | ground  | true        | 4USD         |
| two     | express | false       | 12USD        |
| heavy   | ground  | false       | 35USD        |
| heavy   | express | true        | 60USD        |
| empty   | ground  | false       | 0USD         |

sequence two
| weight |
| 40lb   |
| 25lb   |

sequence heavy
| weight |
| 90lb   |
| 70lb   |

sequence empty
| weight |

rule クーポン割引(coupon_discount) v1
description "クーポン1枚の適用可否と割引額。順序と反復は呼び出し側。出典: 楽天/Yahoo の公開ヘルプから再構成"
# ※ 出力セルに名前を書ける（§3.2 で採用済み）。式は書けないので、率引きは定義を一枚挟む

enum 種別(kind)  = 率引き(rate) | 額引き(amount) | 送料無料(free_ship)
enum 適用範囲(scope) = 店内全商品(shop) default | 対象商品(item)

inputs
  元価(list)        : money[円,incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=1000万円   # 率引きの基準
  現在残額(running) : money[円,incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=1000万円   # 額引きの基準（率引き適用後）
  クーポン種別(kind) : 種別
  クーポン範囲(scope): 適用範囲
  割引率(rate)      : rate[step 1%]
  割引額面(face)    : money[円,incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円
  上限額(cap)       : money[円,incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円
  最低購入額(min)   : money[円,incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円
  同商品適用済(used): bool
  期限内(alive)     : bool

outputs
  割引額(discount) : money[円,incl_tax]  round down(1円)

# [導出] 実表が要求した形。どちらも「入力 − 入力」の線形結合
derive 最低差(min_gap) : money[円,incl_tax] = 現在残額 − 最低購入額  range >=-100万円 <=1000万円
derive 支払差(pay_gap) : money[円,incl_tax] = 現在残額 − 割引額面    range >=-100万円 <=1000万円

table 適用可否(applicable)
policy first
| 期限内 | 同商品適用済 | クーポン範囲 | クーポン種別 | 最低差 | 支払差 | -> 可否(ok) : bool |
| false  | -            | -            | -            | -      | -      | false              |
| -      | true         | 対象商品     | -            | -      | -      | false              |
| -      | -            | -            | -            | <0円   | -      | false              |
| -      | -            | -            | 額引き       | -      | <=0円  | false              |
| -      | -            | -            | -            | -      | -      | true               |

# 率引きは元価基準、額引きは割引後（現在残額）基準 — 楽天の原文どおり
define 率割引(rate_off) : money[円,incl_tax] = 元価 × 割引率

table 素の割引(raw_discount)
policy unique
| 可否  | クーポン種別 | -> 素割引(raw) : money[円,incl_tax] |
| false | -            | 0円                                 |
| true  | 率引き       | 率割引                              |
| true  | 額引き       | 割引額面                            |
| true  | 送料無料     | 0円                                 |

result 割引額 = down(min(素割引, 上限額), 1円)

examples
| 元価    | 現在残額 | クーポン種別 | クーポン範囲 | 割引率 | 割引額面 | 上限額 | 最低購入額 | 同商品適用済 | 期限内 | -> 割引額 |
| 10000円 | 10000円  | 率引き       | 店内全商品   | 10%    | 0円      | 1000円 | 5000円     | false        | true   | 1000円    |
| 10000円 | 9000円   | 額引き       | 店内全商品   | 0%     | 500円    | 500円  | 5000円     | false        | true   | 500円     |
| 10000円 | 400円    | 額引き       | 店内全商品   | 0%     | 500円    | 500円  | 0円        | false        | true   | 0円       |

rule 買物かごの送料(cart_shipping) v1
description "明細の金額を合計して送料を決める。並びを合計する例"

enum 会員区分(tier) = 一般(regular) | 優待(premium)

inputs
  区分(tier) : 会員区分

# 一件ぶんの明細。呼び出し側は何件でも渡す
elements 明細(lines)
  金額(amount) : money[円]  range >=0円 <=100000円

# 歩いたあとに残るのは合計だけ。範囲は完全性の全体集合であり、走っている途中の合計が
# ここを出た時点で入口が受け付けなくなる境目でもある
sum 合計(total) over 明細 of 金額  range >=0円 <=1000000円

outputs
  送料(fee) : money[円]  round up(1円)

table 送料表(fee_table)
policy unique
| 合計             | 区分 | -> 送料(fee) : money[円] |
| >=5000円         | -    | 0円                      |
| >=3000円 <5000円 | 優待 | 0円                      |
| >=3000円 <5000円 | 一般 | 250円                    |
| <3000円          | -    | 500円                    |

rule 送料(shipping_fee) v4
description "設計文書 §1.2 のスケッチを規則にしたもの。真偽定義を列に使う正常系と、率の出力、default の印、policy first の要確認 1 対が出てくる"

import std/都道府県

enum 会員区分(member_kind) = 一般(basic) default | ゴールド(gold) default | プラチナ(platinum)
group 遠隔地(remote) = 北海道, 沖縄県

inputs
  届け先(dest)    : 都道府県
  重量(weight)    : mass[g]        range >=1g <=40kg
  注文金額(total) : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=1000万円
  会員(member)    : 会員区分

outputs
  送料(fee) : money[円, incl_tax]  round up(10円)

# 真偽の定義。条件は入力ひとつを見るだけなので、展開すれば区画の足し合わせになる（§5.3、§6.2）
define 大口(bulk) : bool = 注文金額 >= 3万円

table 基本送料(base_fee)
policy unique
| 届け先      | 重量    | -> 基本送料(base) : money[円, incl_tax] |
| 遠隔地      | <=2000g | 1200円                                  |
| 遠隔地      | >2000g  | 1800円                                  |
| not: 遠隔地 | <=2000g | 800円                                   |
| not: 遠隔地 | >2000g  | 1100円                                  |

table 負担判定(payer)
policy first
| 大口 | 会員     | -> 負担率(pay_rate) : rate |
| true | -        | 0%                         |
| -    | プラチナ | 50%                        |
| -    | -        | 100%                       |

result 送料 = 基本送料 × 負担率

examples
| 届け先 | 重量  | 注文金額 | 会員     | -> 送料 |
| 沖縄県 | 2500g | 40000円  | 一般     | 0円     |
| 東京都 | 1999g | 12000円  | プラチナ | 400円   |
| 北海道 | 500g  | 5000円   | 一般     | 1200円  |

dates refund_terms v1
description "A refund can be asked for until 30 days after the order was paid, moved to the next business day in England and Wales when that day is closed. A sketch of a shop's own terms, written for sekisho's example"
use calendar "../calendars/england_and_wales.cal"

inputs
  paid_on : date  range >=2026-01-01 <=2028-11-25

date last_day = paid_on
  + 30 days             # until 30 days after the order was paid
  roll following        # on the next business day when that day is closed

claims
  on_a_business_day       : last_day is open
  at_least_30_days        : last_day >= paid_on + 30 days
  later_payment_later_day : last_day is monotonic

examples
| paid_on    | -> last_day |
| 2026-10-06 | 2026-11-05  |
| 2026-11-26 | 2026-12-29  |

workflow returns v1
description "When a returned item is back at the warehouse, refund the order. Written for sekisho's example: the workflow calls the shop's API as itself, and the gate refunds.gate decides whether it may"

use openapi orders from "../api/orders.json"

record Refund
  id : string

inputs
  order_id : string
  amount   : money[GBP, incl_tax]  range >=1 <=50

outputs
  refund : string

task refund_order(orderId: string, amount: money[GBP, incl_tax] range >=1 <=10000) -> Refund
  http POST orders "/orders/{orderId}/refunds"
  errors denied = 403
  key

flow
  let r = refund_order(orderId: order_id, amount: amount)
    on denied => fail Denied "The gate did not let the workflow refund this order"
  succeed refund = r.id
gate refunds v1
description "Who may look at an order of the shop, refund it, and export the record of refunds. A sketch of a shop's own terms, written as sekisho's example"
namespace Shop

use rule refund_limit from "rules/refund_limit.rule"
use dates refund_terms from "dates/refund_terms.cal"
use calendar uk from "calendars/england_and_wales.cal"
use openapi orders from "api/orders.json"

# The day of the request, taken from the clock of the server that asks the gate; the day changes at
# midnight UTC. The check walks every day of this range, and the generated code refuses any other.
today range >=2026-10-01 <=2028-10-31 offset +00:00

enum order_status = paid | shipped | returned | refunded

role clerk
  description "Answers customers, and refunds small amounts"
  can view_order, refund_order

role manager
  description "Refunds what a clerk cannot, and after the refund period on a business day"
  includes clerk
  can view_order, refund_order

role auditor
  description "Checks the refunds after the fact"
  can view_order, export_refunds

principal User
  description "A member of the shop's staff, signed in"
  roles clerk, manager, auditor
  attributes
    refund_limit : money[GBP, incl_tax]  range >=0GBP <=10_000GBP
    suspended    : bool

principal Customer
  description "A customer of the shop, signed in"

workflow returns from "flows/returns.flow"
  description "Refunds a returned order once the item is back at the warehouse"

resource Order
  description "An order of the shop"
  attributes
    status   : order_status
    paid_on  : date  range >=2026-01-01 <=2028-09-30
    customer : Customer

resource RefundRecord
  description "The record of every refund, exported as one document"

action view_order
  description "Look at an order"
  guards orders getOrder
  principal User, Customer
  resource Order from orderId

action refund_order
  description "Refund an order, in part or in whole"
  guards orders refundOrder
  principal User, Workflow
  resource Order from orderId
  input
    amount : money[GBP, incl_tax]  range >=1GBP <=10_000GBP
  context
    refund_band  = refund_limit(amount: amount, limit: principal.refund_limit).band
    in_period    = today <= refund_terms.last_day(paid_on: resource.paid_on)
    business_day = today is open in uk

action export_refunds
  description "Export the record of refunds"
  guards orders exportRefunds
  principal User
  resource RefundRecord

permit staff_view_orders
  description "The staff look at any order"
  principal in clerk, auditor
  action view_order

permit customers_view_their_orders
  description "A customer looks at their own orders"
  principal is Customer
  action view_order
  when resource.customer is principal

permit clerks_refund_within_their_limit
  description "A clerk refunds up to the clerk's own limit, while the refund period lasts"
  principal in clerk
  action refund_order
  when refund_band is within_limit
  when in_period

permit managers_refund_in_period
  description "A manager refunds any amount while the refund period lasts"
  principal in manager
  action refund_order
  when in_period

permit managers_refund_late_on_business_days
  description "After the refund period, a manager may still refund, on a business day in England and Wales"
  principal in manager
  action refund_order
  unless in_period
  when business_day

permit returns_refunds_returned_orders
  description "The returns workflow refunds a returned order, up to 50 pounds"
  principal is workflow returns
  action refund_order
  when resource.status is returned
  when amount <= 50GBP

permit auditors_export_refunds
  description "An auditor exports the record of refunds"
  principal in auditor
  action export_refunds

forbid no_second_refund
  description "An order already refunded is not refunded again"
  action refund_order
  when resource.status is refunded

forbid auditors_do_not_refund
  description "Whoever audits the refunds does not refund"
  principal in auditor
  action refund_order

forbid suspended_staff_do_nothing
  description "A suspended member of the staff does nothing"
  principal is User
  action any
  when principal.suspended

expect deny clerks_never_refund_over_their_limit
  description "A clerk who is not a manager never refunds more than the clerk's own limit"
  principal in clerk
  action refund_order
  unless principal in manager
  when refund_band is over_limit

expect deny nothing_refunded_twice
  description "No one refunds an order that is already refunded"
  action refund_order
  when resource.status is refunded

expect allow managers_refund_in_period
  description "A manager who is not suspended and does not audit refunds an order not yet refunded, while the period lasts"
  principal in manager
  action refund_order
  unless principal in auditor
  unless principal.suspended
  unless resource.status is refunded
  when in_period

separate refunding_and_auditing
  description "The people who refund are not the people who audit the refunds"
  actions refund_order, export_refunds

gate 返金(refunds_ja) v1
description "店の注文を見ること、返金すること、返金の記録を書き出すことを、だれがしてよいか。店の決まりの一例として書いた sekisho の例で、refunds.gate の日本語の版"
namespace ShopJa

use rule 返金の上限 from "rules/返金の上限.rule"
use dates 返金の期限 from "dates/返金の期限.cal"
use calendar 英国 from "calendars/england_and_wales.cal"
use openapi 注文 from "api/orders.json"

# リクエストの日。ゲートに問い合わせるサーバーの時計から取り、UTC の 0 時に変わる。

today range >=2026-10-01 <=2028-10-31 offset +00:00

rule refund_limit v1
description "Whether a refund is within the limit of the person who asks for it. A sketch of a shop's own terms, written for sekisho's example; it is not a transcription of any document"

enum refund_band = within_limit | over_limit

inputs
  amount : money[GBP, incl_tax]  range >=1GBP <=10_000GBP
  limit  : money[GBP, incl_tax]  range >=0GBP <=10_000GBP

outputs
  band : refund_band

derive excess : money[GBP, incl_tax] = amount - limit  range >=-9_999GBP <=10_000GBP

table decide
policy unique
| excess | -> band : refund_band |
| <=0GBP | within_limit          |
| >0GBP  | over_limit            |

examples
| amount | limit  | -> band       |
| 50GBP  | 100GBP | within_limit  |
| 100GBP | 100GBP | within_limit  |
| 101GBP | 100GBP | over_limit    |
| 1GBP   | 0GBP   | over_limit    |

rule 出荷の急ぎ(urgency) v1
description "注文を急ぎで出すかどうかと、使う便。会員はいつも急ぎ、それ以外は三万円以上なら急ぎ。書き下ろしの例"

enum 便(carrier) = 通常便(standard) | 翌日便(next_day)

inputs
  会員(member) : bool
  金額(amount) : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円

outputs
  急ぎ(urgent) : bool
  便(carrier)  : 便

table 急ぎの判定(decide)
policy unique
| 会員  | 金額      | -> 急ぎ | 便     |
| true  | -         | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | >=30000円 | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | <30000円  | false   | 通常便 |

examples
| 会員  | 金額    | -> 急ぎ | 便     |
| true  | 1000円  | true    | 翌日便 |
| false | 5000円  | false   | 通常便 |
| false | 30000円 | true    | 翌日便 |

rule 注文の状態(order_state) v1
description "通販の注文が、入金・出荷・配達・取消依頼のイベントでどの状態に移り、いくら返金するか。状態は呼び出す側が持ち、規則は一回のイベントだけを判定する。書き下ろしの例"

enum 状態(state) = 受付(received) | 入金済(paid) | 出荷済(shipped) | 配達済(delivered) | 取消(cancelled)
enum イベント(event) = 入金(pay) | 出荷(ship) | 配達(deliver) | 取消依頼(cancel)

inputs
  状態(state)     : 状態
  イベント(event) : イベント
  支払額(paid)    : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0円 <=100万円

outputs
  次の状態(next_state) : 状態
  返金額(refund)       : money[円, incl_tax]  round down(1円)
  受理(accepted)       : bool

table 遷移(step)
policy unique
| 状態   | イベント             | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 受付   | 入金                 | 入金済      | 0円    | true  |
| 受付   | 取消依頼             | 取消        | 0円    | true  |
| 受付   | 出荷, 配達           | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 入金済 | 出荷                 | 出荷済      | 0円    | true  |
| 入金済 | 取消依頼             | 取消        | 支払額 | true  |
| 入金済 | 入金, 配達           | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 出荷済 | 配達                 | 配達済      | 0円    | true  |
| 出荷済 | 入金, 出荷, 取消依頼 | 状態        | 0円    | false |  # 出荷のあとの取消は、返品の手続きで受ける
| 配達済 | -                    | 状態        | 0円    | false |
| 取消   | -                    | 状態        | 0円    | false |  # 取消のあとに届いた入金の通知では、注文を戻さない

machine 注文(order) over 遷移
  carry   状態 -> 次の状態
  held    支払額
  initial 受付
  final   配達済, 取消
  never   出荷済 after 取消
  once    返金額 >0円

scenario 配達まで(delivered)
| イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理 |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 入金済      | 0円    | true |
| 出荷     | 3000円 | 出荷済      | 0円    | true |
| 配達     | 3000円 | 配達済      | 0円    | true |

scenario 取消のあとの入金(late_pay)
| イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 入金済      | 0円    | true  |
| 取消依頼 | 3000円 | 取消        | 3000円 | true  |
| 入金     | 3000円 | 取消        | 0円    | false |

examples
| 状態   | イベント | 支払額 | -> 次の状態 | 返金額 | 受理  |
| 受付   | 取消依頼 | 0円    | 取消        | 0円    | true  |
| 出荷済 | 取消依頼 | 3000円 | 出荷済      | 0円    | false |
texts.website/playground/shop.ja/ordering/出荷.f:
workflow 出荷 v1
description "倉庫のシステムにある注文について、入金を催促し、出荷させ、配達の知らせを待つ。注文の状態は倉庫のシステムが持ち、その移り方は rulec の規則「注文の状態」に従う。Temporal 向けの版：倉庫の呼び出しは dandori が生成するアクティビティで、お知らせは自分で書くアクティビティ。配達のことは、運送会社のシステムが注文の ID を宛先にして知らせる（event）。お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、倉庫でも取り消す（on cancel）。催促のループは、履歴が長くなると新しい実行に引き継ぐ"

use rule 注文の状態 from "rules/注文の状態.rule"
use rule 急ぎ from "rules/出荷の急ぎ.rule"

record 注文
  id   : string
  状態 : 注文の状態.状態
  金額 : money[円, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  会員 : bool

record 受付
  id : string

inputs
  注文ID : string

outputs
  便 : 急ぎ.便

task 注文を見る(id: string, expand: string) -> 注文
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors 混雑 = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on 混雑

task 出荷を頼む(id: string, 便: 急ぎ.便) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends 出荷
  errors 拒否された = 409
  refused as 拒否された
  key

task 取消を頼む(id: string) -> 注文
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends 取消依頼
  errors 拒否された = 409
  refused as 拒否された
  key

# お店の通知サービス。自分で書くコードから呼ぶ。
task 知らせる(注文ID: string, 本文: string) -> 受付
  errors 宛先なし
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# 運送会社のシステムは、配達を報告したとき、倉庫にあるそのときの注文を、注文のワークフローに送る。
task 配達の知らせ() -> 注文
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case 受注 : 注文 follows 注文の状態.注文
  external 入金, 配達, 取消依頼
  refused when 受理 = false

flow
  受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 注文ID, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match 受注.状態
      受付 =>
        let 催促の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "お支払いをお待ちしています")
          on 宛先なし => fail 連絡先なし leaving 受注
        wait 1 day
        受注 <- 注文を見る(id: 受注.id, expand: "items")
      入金済, 出荷済, 配達済, 取消 => break
  match 受注.状態
    受付 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 拒否された => pass
      fail 未入金 "三日たっても入金がありませんでした"
    取消 => fail 取消済み "取り消された注文です"
    出荷済, 配達済 => fail 既に出荷 "もう出荷されています" leaving 受注
    入金済 => pass
  let 判定 = 急ぎ(会員: 受注.会員, 金額: 受注.金額)
  受注 <- 出荷を頼む(id: 受注.id, 便: 判定.便)
    on 拒否された => fail 取消済み "出荷の前に取り消されました"
  match 判定.急ぎ
    true => let 出荷の控え = 知らせる(注文ID: 受注.id, 本文: "翌日便で出荷しました")
    false => pass
  受注 <- 配達の知らせ()
    on timeout => fail 配達の遅れ "七日たっても配達の知らせがありません" leaving 受注
  match 受注.状態
    配達済 => succeed 便 = 判定.便
    出荷済 => fail 配達の遅れ "配達の知らせのあとも出荷済のままです" leaving 受注

on failure
  fail 中断 "途中で止まりました。注文は倉庫のシステムにそのまま残ります" leaving 受注

# お店が途中で注文を取り消すと、ワークフローはキャンセルされ、まだ出荷していなければ倉庫にも取消を頼む。
on cancel
  match 受注.状態
    none => pass
    受付, 入金済 =>
      受注 <- 取消を頼む(id: 受注.id)
        on 拒否された => fail 出荷後の取消 "倉庫が注文 {受注.id} の取消を拒否しました。出荷されたのかもしれません" leaving 受注
        on failure => fail 取消の失敗 "倉庫で注文 {受注.id} を取り消せませんでした" leaving 受注
    出荷済 => fail 出荷後の取消 "注文 {受注.id} はもう出荷されています" leaving 受注

gate orders v1
description "Who may look at an order of the shop, and who may cancel it. Whether an order can be cancelled at all is the rule order_state's to say, the rule the workflow that ships it follows. Written for the example"
namespace Shop

use rule order_state from "../ordering/rules/order_state.rule"
use calendar shop_days from "../billing/shop_days.cal"
use proto shop from "../proto/shop/v1/order.proto"

# The day of the request, from the clock of the server that asks the gate; the day changes at
# midnight in Japan. The check walks every day of this range, and the generated code refuses any other.
today range >=2026-10-01 <=2027-12-31 offset +09:00

enum state = received | paid | shipped | delivered | cancelled

role clerk
  description "Answers customers, and cancels orders for them"
  can view_order, cancel_order

principal Staff
  description "A member of the shop's staff, signed in"
  roles clerk

principal Customer
  description "A customer of the shop, signed in"

resource Order
  description "An order of the shop"
  attributes
    state       : state
    amount_paid : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0JPY <=1000000JPY
    customer    : Customer

action view_order
  description "Look at an order"
  guards shop "OrderService/GetOrder"
  principal Staff, Customer
  resource Order from id

action cancel_order
  description "Cancel an order before it ships; a paid order is refunded what was paid"
  guards shop "OrderService/CancelOrder"
  principal Staff, Customer
  resource Order from id
  context
    cancellable = order_state(state: resource.state, event: cancel, amount_paid: resource.amount_paid).accepted
    office_open = today is open in shop_days

permit staff_view_orders
  description "The staff look at any order"
  principal in clerk
  action view_order

permit customers_view_their_orders
  description "A customer looks at their own orders"
  principal is Customer
  action view_order
  when resource.customer is principal

permit customers_cancel_their_unpaid_orders
  description "A customer cancels their own order while it waits for the payment"
  principal is Customer
  action cancel_order
  when resource.customer is principal
  when cancellable
  unless resource.state is paid

permit clerks_cancel_unpaid_orders
  description "A clerk cancels an order that waits for the payment"
  principal in clerk
  action cancel_order
  when cancellable
  unless resource.state is paid

permit clerks_refund_on_office_days
  description "A clerk cancels a paid order on a day the office is open: cancelling it refunds the payment, which the accounts team pays out"
  principal in clerk
  action cancel_order
  when cancellable
  when resource.state is paid
  when office_open

expect deny nothing_shipped_is_cancelled
  description "No one cancels an order that has shipped: it comes back as a return"
  action cancel_order
  when resource.state is shipped or resource.state is delivered

expect deny customers_do_not_refund
  description "A customer never cancels an order that is paid: a refund is the staff's to make"
  principal is Customer
  action cancel_order
  when resource.state is paid
texts.website/playground/shop/ordering/rules/o:
rule order_state v1
description "Where an online order goes on a payment, a shipment, a delivery or a request to cancel it, and how much is refunded. The caller keeps the state; the rule decides one event at a time. Written for the example"

enum state = received | paid | shipped | delivered | cancelled
enum event = pay | ship | deliver | cancel

inputs
  state       : state
  event       : event
  amount_paid : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0JPY <=1000000JPY

outputs
  next_state : state
  refund     : money[JPY, incl_tax]  round down(1JPY)
  accepted   : bool

table step
policy unique
| state     | event             | -> next_state | refund      | accepted |
| received  | pay               | paid          | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | cancel            | cancelled     | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | ship, deliver     | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| paid      | ship              | shipped       | 0JPY        | true     |
| paid      | cancel            | cancelled     | amount_paid | true     |
| paid      | pay, deliver      | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| shipped   | deliver           | delivered     | 0JPY        | true     |
| shipped   | pay, ship, cancel | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a cancel after the shipment goes through a return
| delivered | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| cancelled | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a payment that comes after a cancel does not bring the order back

machine order over step
  carry   state -> next_state
  held    amount_paid
  initial received
  final   delivered, cancelled
  never   shipped after cancelled
  once    refund >0JPY

scenario delivered
| event   | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| pay     | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY   | true     |
| ship    | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | true     |
| deliver | 3000JPY     | delivered     | 0JPY   | true     |

scenario late_pay
| event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund  | accepted |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | paid          | 0JPY    | true     |
| cancel | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 3000JPY | true     |
| pay    | 3000JPY     | cancelled     | 0JPY    | false    |

examples
| state    | event  | amount_paid | -> next_state | refund | accepted |
| received | cancel | 0JPY        | cancelled     | 0JPY   | true     |
| shipped  | cancel | 3000JPY     | shipped       | 0JPY   | false    |

texts.website/playground/shop/ordering/ship_or:
workflow ship_order v1
description "For an order in the warehouse's system, ask for the payment, have it shipped, and wait for word of the delivery. The warehouse's system keeps the order's state, which moves as rulec's rule order_state says. Written for Temporal: the warehouse's calls are activities dandori writes, and the notice is an activity you write; the carrier's system tells the workflow of the order about the delivery, by the order's id (an event); and an order the shop cancels on the way is cancelled at the warehouse too (on cancel). The loop over the reminders goes on in a new run when its history grows long"

use rule order_state from "rules/order_state.rule"
use rule urgency from "rules/urgency.rule"

record Order
  id     : string
  state  : order_state.state
  amount : money[JPY, incl_tax]  range >=0 <=1000000
  member : bool

record Receipt
  id : string

inputs
  order_id : string

outputs
  carrier : urgency.carrier

task get_order(id: string, expand: string) -> Order
  http GET "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}"
  observes
  idempotent
  errors busy = 429
  retry 3 times every 1 second on busy

task request_shipment(id: string, carrier: urgency.carrier) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/shipments"
  sends ship
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

task request_cancel(id: string) -> Order
  http POST "https://warehouse.example.com/v1/orders/{id}/cancellations"
  sends cancel
  errors conflict = 409
  refused as conflict
  key

# The shop's own notice service, called from code you write.
task notify(order_id: string, text: string) -> Receipt
  errors no_recipient
  key
  retry 2 times every 5 seconds

# The carrier's system sends the order as the warehouse has it now to the workflow of the
# order when the carrier reports the delivery.
task delivered() -> Order
  event
  observes
  timeout 7 days

case order : Order follows order_state.order
  external pay, deliver, cancel
  refused when accepted = false

flow
  order <- get_order(id: order_id, expand: "items")
  repeat at most 3 times
    match order.state
      received =>
        let r = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "We are waiting for your payment")
          on no_recipient => fail NoContact leaving order
        wait 1 day
        order <- get_order(id: order.id, expand: "items")
      paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled => break
  match order.state
    received =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => pass
      fail NotPaid "No payment came in three days"
    cancelled => fail Canceled "The order was canceled"
    shipped, delivered => fail AlreadyShipped "The order has shipped already" leaving order
    paid => pass
  let decision = urgency(member: order.member, amount: order.amount)
  order <- request_shipment(id: order.id, carrier: decision.carrier)
    on conflict => fail Canceled "The order was canceled before it shipped"
  match decision.urgent
    true => let n = notify(order_id: order.id, text: "Shipped by next-day delivery")
    false => pass
  order <- delivered()
    on timeout => fail DeliveryLate "No word of the delivery in seven days" leaving order
  match order.state
    delivered => succeed carrier = decision.carrier
    shipped => fail DeliveryLate "Still shipped after word of the delivery" leaving order

on failure
  fail Stopped "Stopped on the way; the order stays in the warehouse's system as it is" leaving order

# The shop cancels the order on the way: the workflow is cancelled, and the warehouse is asked to
# cancel the order too, unless it has gone out.
on cancel
  match order.state
    none => pass
    received, paid =>
      order <- request_cancel(id: order.id)
        on conflict => fail ShippedAlready "The warehouse refused to cancel order {order.id}; it may have shipped" leaving order
        on failure => fail CancelFailed "Could not cancel order {order.id} at the warehouse" leaving order
    shipped => fail ShippedAlready "Order {order.id} has shipped already" leaving order

table step
policy unique
| state     | event             | -> next_state | refund      | accepted |
| received  | pay               | paid          | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | cancel            | cancelled     | 0JPY        | true     |
| received  | ship, deliver     | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| paid      | ship              | shipped       | 0JPY        | true     |
| paid      | cancel            | cancelled     | amount_paid | true     |
| paid      | pay, deliver      | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| shipped   | deliver           | delivered     | 0JPY        | true     |
| shipped   | pay, ship, cancel | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a cancel after the shipment goes through a return
| delivered | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |
| cancelled | -                 | state         | 0JPY        | false    |  # a payment that comes after a cancel does not bring the order back

texts.website/playground/shop/warehouse/invent:
# Stock held for an order: within 30 minutes it ships or is cancelled.
book inventory v1
description "Stock per SKU. A delivery adds to it, an order holds what it takes for 30 minutes, shipping posts the hold, cancelling voids it, and a return puts the goods back on the shelves"

unit pcs

account stock(sku: string) : pcs
  description "what is on the shelves"
  at least 0 refused as out_of_stock
account suppliers : pcs outside
account customers : pcs outside

transfer receive(delivery: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  key delivery, sku
  move qty from suppliers to stock(sku)

transfer reserve(order: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  description "posted when the order ships, voided when it is cancelled"
  key order, sku
  pending expires after 30 minutes
  move qty from stock(sku) to customers

transfer take_back(return_id: string, sku: string, qty: pcs)
  description "what a customer sent back, on the shelves again"
  key return_id, sku
  move qty from customers to stock(sku)
